author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager, GPay
job_description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 7 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from concept to launch.
* Experience with Growth in a fast paced environment (especially in Consumer facing Mobile first areas).
* Experience and interest in building large-scale platforms.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

As a Product Manager leading the Transit and Mobile Recharge verticals within Google Pay (GPay) India, you will own the overall direction, strategy, and execution for two of GPay's highest-frequency engagement drivers. In this role, you will define end-to-end product roadmaps across daily-commute transit experiences as well as Mobile Recharge product strategy and growth across - Platform, AI experiences, UX, performance and more. You will serve as the core strategic owner bridging product innovation, internal cross-functional execution (Engineering, UX, Analytics, Legal, Business Development), and critical external ecosystem partnerships with Telecom companies, Aggregators, regulators, public transport operators, and more to scale daily and monthly usage and engagement amongst users across India.

Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define and execute the multi-year product strategy for Transit and Mobile Recharge verticals on GPay India, translating complex daily utility needs and regulatory standards into intuitive, high-scale GPay experiences.
* Lead the end to end product portfolio across Growth, Platformization, Scalability, Reliability, Obsersability, AI experiences and new opportunities at massive scale.
* Lead buildout of the Transit space on GPay —driving initiatives across NCMC, QR Ticketing and other first-party and third-party experiences.
* Establish a close working relationship with key ecosystem partners (NPCI, Bharat Connect, aggregators, issuers and others) to navigate compliance , unblock technical dependencies, and lead cross-functional growth tracks to eliminate funnel friction and maximize user engagement.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Lead Product Manager
job_description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a **Lead Product Manager** within the Commercial Bank to serve as a Product Owner responsible for driving execution of strategic product initiatives and delivering customer and business value through agile product teams. This role will partner closely with Product Managers, Technology Leaders, Architects, Operations, Risk, and business stakeholders to translate strategic priorities into actionable product capabilities, ensuring successful delivery of solutions that meet customer needs, regulatory requirements, and operational objectives.

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead one or more product teams in delivering business and customer value through execution of product initiatives aligned with established product strategies and roadmaps.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities, customer needs, risk requirements, and regulatory commitments.
* Collaborate with L2/L3 Product Managers and stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into actionable epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Drive backlog refinement, sprint planning, release planning, product reviews, and demonstrations to ensure effective execution and delivery.
* Partner with technology, architecture, operations, and business teams to define solutions and ensure successful implementation of product enhancements and capabilities.
* Facilitate prioritization decisions across competing demands while balancing customer value, operational efficiency, technical dependencies, and regulatory requirements.
* Manage cross-functional dependencies, identify delivery risks, remove impediments, and drive timely resolution of issues impacting product delivery.
* Validate business requirements and acceptance criteria to ensure delivered solutions meet customer expectations, quality standards, and business objectives.
* Monitor product area performance, user adoption, operational outcomes, and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Support process automation, AI-enabled capabilities, and modernization initiatives that enhance customer experience and operational effectiveness.
* Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Control partners to ensure solutions adhere to enterprise policies, governance frameworks, and regulatory requirements.
* Communicate product priorities, delivery progress, risks, and outcomes to stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Drive a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and Agile best practices across the product team.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior Product Owners and team members while promoting effective product management practices.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or equivalent experience.
* Experience leading Agile product delivery teams and managing backlogs within complex enterprise environments.
* Strong experience defining user stories, acceptance criteria, business requirements, and release planning activities.
* Experience working closely with engineers, architects, designers, and business stakeholders to deliver technology solutions.
* Proven ability to manage competing priorities, dependencies, risks, and delivery commitments across multiple workstreams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Experience using Agile delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to influence outcomes and drive execution in matrixed organizational environments.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience in Commercial Banking, Supply Chain Finance, Lending, Receivables Finance, Treasury Management, Payments, or related banking domains.
* Experience supporting platform modernization, workflow automation, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Knowledge of banking regulatory, risk, and control frameworks.
* Experience with SQL, Power BI, data analytics, and reporting tools.
* Familiarity with AI, Generative AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven product decision making.
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and modern product operating models.

**Posting End Date:**

18 Nov 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

**Applicants with Disabilities**

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

**Drug and Alcohol Policy**

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

**Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:**

a. Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.

b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

c. Please be prepared to provide accurate information and supporting documentation in connection with any lawful employment and education verification conducted by Wells Fargo.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**About the Team**

Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.

Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us.

We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.

But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs, to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about solving high impact problems in a fast paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category mgmt., marketing, operations, finance, etc to bring a new product to life.

### **What will you do**

* Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the e-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engg., business, etc. Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engineering, business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.
* Team Leadership: Manage a small team of product analysts and associate product managers, and guide them towards product execution.

### **What you will need**

* Overall experience of 7+ yrs with atleast 5+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)
* Exceptional problem solving skills based on first principles thinking
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps

### **About us**

Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.

**Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.**

### **Our Mission**

Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.

We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.

Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.

### **Culture and Total Rewards**

Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.

Total rewards at Meesho comprise a comprehensive set of elements — monetary, non-monetary, tangible, and intangible. Our 9 guiding principles, or "Mantras," are the backbone of how we operate, influencing everything from recognition and evaluation to growth discussions. Daily rituals and processes like “Problem First Mindset,” “Listen or Die,” our Internal Mobility Program, Talent Reviews, and Continuous Performance Management embody these principles.

We offer competitive compensation — both cash and equity-based — tailored to job roles, individual experience, and skill, along with employee-centric benefits and a supportive work environment. Our holistic wellness program, MeeCare, includes benefits across physical, mental, financial, and social wellness. This includes extensive medical insurance for employees and their families, wellness initiatives like telehealth, wellness events, and fitness-related perks.

To support work-life balance, we offer generous leave policies, parental support, retirement benefits, and learning and development assistance. Through personalized recognition, gratitude for stretched work, and engaging activities, we promote employee delight at the workplace. Additional benefits such as salary advance support, relocation assistance, and flexible benefit plans further enrich the Meesho experience.

At Meesho, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where every individual can thrive. In compliance with the **Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016**, we uphold the following principles:

* **Equal Opportunity**: We ensure that employment opportunities are never denied on the grounds of disability if the candidate is otherwise competent to perform the job.
* **Accessible Workplace**: Our facilities are designed to be fully accessible, with amenities and assistive devices provided to support differently abled individuals in their work.
* **Inclusive Hiring Process**: We adopt a transparent and non-discriminatory selection process, including providing application forms in alternate formats and offering reasonable accommodations during interviews upon request.
* **Career Growth**: We provide adequate training post-recruitment and pre-promotion, with training materials available in accessible formats to enable equal career progression.
* **Support & Confidentiality**: A dedicated liaison officer/committee addresses concerns and grievances, while maintaining strict confidentiality of disability-related information.
* **Awareness & Inclusion**: We conduct awareness programs to promote a culture of inclusivity across the organization.

Meesho welcomes applicants and employees of all abilities and is dedicated to fostering an environment where differently abled persons can achieve their full potential.

Know more about Meesho here : https://www.meesho.io/

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Gather business requirements and translate them into functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Define product roadmaps, manage backlogs and prioritize features based on business requirements and technical feasibility.
* Work closely with engineering and QA teams to drive end-to-end product development and delivery.
* Understand and contribute to technical discussions around Microservices Architecture, REST APIs, databases, Kafka and distributed systems.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog refinement, UAT and product releases.
* Identify opportunities to integrate Generative AI, LLMs and AI-powered automation into software products.
* Monitor product performance, user feedback and continuously improve product capabilities.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 years of overall experience, preferably including 2–3 years in software development followed by experience in Product Management / Product Ownership.
* Prior hands-on development experience in Node.js, Express.js, NestJS or similar backend technologies.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile/Scrum and software architecture.
* Knowledge of Microservices Architecture, distributed systems and Event-Driven Architecture.
* Working knowledge of Apache Kafka, REST APIs, SQL, databases and system integrations.
* Experience in product backlog management, requirement gathering, user stories and feature prioritization.
* Hands on experience on CI/CD pipeline.
* Familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, Postman, Swagger or similar tools.
* Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

**Company Description**

Launched in 2007 by Aloke Bajpai & Rajnish Kumar, ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited) is a technology company focused on empowering Indian travellers to plan, book and manage their trips across rail, air, buses and hotels. ixigo assists travellers in making smarter travel decisions by leveraging artificial intelligence. The ixigo, ConfirmTkt and AbhiBus apps allow travellers to book train tickets, flight tickets, bus tickets, hotels, and cabs, and provide travel utility tools and services developed using in-house proprietary algorithms and crowd-sourced information. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in Fiscal 2025, ixigo is the leading OTA for Next Billion Users in India. For more information, please visit http://www.ixigo.com

 **Job Description**

**About the Role:**

As a Product Manager - Flights at ixigo, you will work on the end-to-end flights product, driving growth across the booking funnel while ensuring a reliable, trustworthy experience across the customer journey.

You will balance user experience, business growth, and operational efficiency across a high-volume, high-stakes product area.

**Responsibilities:**

* Flights Product Strategy: Define and execute the roadmap for the flights business, balancing growth, conversion, and customer experience priorities across the funnel
* Post-Booking Experience: Own key post-booking journeys including cancellations, rescheduling, and refunds, working with CX teams to identify and resolve recurring customer pain points
* Booking Funnel Optimization: Own and continuously improve the search-to-book funnel, search relevance, seat/meal selection, add-ons — to reduce drop-offs and improve conversion at every step
* Partner Onboarding & Distribution: Lead the onboarding of new airlines, GDS/NDC partners, and supply sources to expand flight inventory. Additionally, own the B2B API distribution charter — onboarding partners who wish to integrate our flight APIs to sell flights on their own platforms, defining API/product requirements, and ensuring smooth technical and commercial integration for these partners
* Continuous Experimentation: Champion A/B testing across search, discounting, and checkout flows to systematically improve conversion and revenue metrics
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as the central node between Design, Backend, Frontend, Analytics, and the AI/ML teams. You will translate complex business needs into PRDs and user-centric designs
* Data-Driven Optimization: Define and track North Star metrics such as funnel conversion rate, supply coverage, partner integration TAT, and customer satisfaction, using these insights to guide roadmap decisions

 **Qualifications**

**Qualifications:**

* 2-5 years of experience in Product Management, ideally within a high-growth B2C tech company, OTA, or travel-tech setting. Experience with funnel optimization, marketplace/supply growth, or partner integrations is a strong plus
* Funnel & Growth Mindset: Strong understanding of conversion funnels and the ability to identify and prioritize high-impact optimizations across search, pricing, and checkout
* User-Centric Mindset: An eye for great UX/UI and a solid understanding of the end-to-end travel booking experience, including post-booking needs
* Technical Fluency: Comfortable discussing API/integration structures with backend teams and airline/GDS systems
* Execution Excellence: Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and ship reliable, high-quality features in an agile environment

**Additional (Preferred):**

* OTA Experience: Familiarity with the nuances of the Indian travel market and seasonal booking patterns
* Partnership & Integration Acumen: Comfort working with airline/GDS/NDC partners and translating commercial and technical integration requirements into a clear onboarding roadmap
* AI/ML Exposure: Direct experience working with data science teams to deploy machine learning models
* Growth Mindset: A "hacker" mentality—constantly looking for small tweaks that lead to outsized gains in conversion

 **Additional Information**

Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

job_description:
**Company:** iFieldSmart Technologies LLC

**Position:** Product Manager

**Experience:** Experienced professional with a B2B SaaS background

**1. Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced, proactive, and execution-oriented Product Manager who will act as a central coordination point between the Sales, Marketing, Product Coordination, and Product Development functions.

The primary responsibility of this role is to take end-to-end ownership of product delivery commitments made to clients by the Sales team and ensure that products currently under development are completed, made market-ready, and successfully handed over to the Marketing team for launch.

The individual will work closely with our existing Product Coordinators, Project Managers, and Program Managers, who are responsible for managing individual products and development programs and coordinating with engineering management and development teams.

The new Product Manager will oversee and coordinate across these program owners, track overall progress, ensure alignment on priorities and deadlines, proactively identify bottlenecks, and take ownership of ensuring that business commitments are fulfilled.

This is a highly coordination-driven and ownership-oriented role requiring someone who can manage multiple priorities, work with cross-functional teams, proactively identify challenges, and drive timely execution.

**2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Client-Specific Product Delivery Management**

· Take complete ownership of product delivery commitments made by the Sales team to different clients.

· Coordinate with the respective Product Coordinators, Project Managers, and Program Managers responsible for the development of those products or features.

· Ensure that client-specific requirements, priorities, and committed delivery timelines are clearly communicated to the respective program owners.

· Maintain proactive tracking of multiple ongoing client deliveries, milestones, dependencies, and deadlines across different programs.

· Regularly follow up with the respective coordinators and program managers to understand development progress and identify potential delays or roadblocks.

· Proactively identify risks, resolve coordination bottlenecks, and escalate critical issues to senior management whenever required.

· Maintain clear communication and alignment between Sales, Marketing, and Product/Program Management teams regarding delivery status, changes, and expectations.

· Ensure that client commitments are not just tracked but successfully fulfilled, taking full accountability for overall delivery outcomes.

**B. Product Completion & Market Launch Management**

· Take ownership of existing products and features that are in the development or finalization stage.

· Work closely with the respective Product Coordinators and Program Managers to ensure pending development activities are completed.

· Track product readiness, identify gaps, and drive closure of pending requirements before launch.

· Coordinate with the concerned program owners to ensure product testing, quality checks, and final readiness activities are completed.

· Ensure completed products and features are properly documented and handed over to the Marketing team.

· Work closely with Marketing to communicate product capabilities, features, use cases, and launch requirements.

· Ensure products are ready for marketing campaigns, customer demonstrations, and commercial rollout.

· Track the overall product launch pipeline and ensure products do not remain indefinitely in the development or finalization stage.

**C. Cross-Functional Coordination & Stakeholder Management**

· Act as the central coordination point between Sales, Marketing, and the existing Product Coordination / Program Management teams.

· Work closely with multiple Product Coordinators, Project Managers, and Program Managers, each responsible for managing different products or development programs.

· Maintain visibility into the progress of all ongoing product development initiatives and client-specific commitments.

· Ensure business priorities, client requirements, and deadlines are aligned with the respective program owners.

· Conduct regular follow-ups and status reviews to ensure timely execution.

· Proactively identify dependencies, delays, resource constraints, and risks that could impact product delivery.

· Coordinate with the relevant program owners to resolve bottlenecks and escalate critical issues to senior management, engineering management, or the CEO whenever necessary.

· Keep senior management informed about delivery progress, critical dependencies, risks, and challenges.

· Ensure smooth information flow between technical and non-technical teams.

**Important clarification about the role:** The Product Manager will primarily coordinate with the existing Product Coordinators, Project Managers, and Program Managers rather than directly managing developers or assigning day-to-day technical development tasks. The respective program owners will continue to manage development execution through engineering management and development teams. However, the new Product Manager will be accountable for tracking and driving overall delivery outcomes.

**3. Candidate Profile & Required Experience**

We are specifically looking for someone with:

· Experience working in a B2B SaaS product company.

· Exposure to international markets and experience working with international clients or customers, preferably the US market.

· Previous experience working in a startup or fast-growing technology company.

· Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, particularly Sales, Product, Program Management, and Engineering functions.

· Experience in product delivery management, program coordination, product operations, or product management.

· Strong project execution, delivery management, and stakeholder management capabilities.

· Ability to manage multiple projects, client commitments, products, and deadlines simultaneously.

· Experience tracking deliverables through multiple project or program owners.

· A proactive approach to identifying problems, following up, and ensuring things get completed.

**4. Preferred Mindset & Additional Requirements**

· Flexible and adaptable to a fast-paced startup environment.

· Willingness to multitask and take ownership beyond narrowly defined responsibilities.

· Strong execution-oriented mindset rather than just planning and reporting.

· Ability and willingness to learn the technical aspects of AI-powered products and solutions.

· Willingness to understand the construction technology industry and its workflows.

· Good communication, coordination, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

· Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

· Ability to work independently, drive accountability, and ensure follow-through without requiring constant supervision.

**5. What We Are Looking For**

The ideal candidate should be able to ensure that:

1. Whatever Sales commits to clients gets delivered within the agreed timelines.

2. All existing Product Coordinators and Program Managers are aligned with business priorities and client delivery commitments.

3. The overall progress of multiple products and development programs is proactively tracked.

4. Potential delivery issues, dependencies, and bottlenecks are identified and addressed before they become major problems.

5. Senior management has clear visibility into product delivery progress and potential risks.

6. Products nearing completion are driven towards launch readiness.

7. Marketing receives completed, properly documented products and features for successful market launches.

8. There is clear coordination and accountability between all business and product-related teams.

**The ideal candidate is an execution-focused Product Manager who can connect business commitments with internal product execution, coordinate multiple program owners, and take complete ownership of getting things delivered.**

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Product Management Product Managers at U.S. Bank are customer obsessed in driving product visioning, planning and development to deliver on our human + digital product strategy and staying one step ahead of evolving economic, technological, and customer needs. As a Product Manager, you will: • Identify, analyze and interpret business data using various kinds of techniques to meet business needs and requirements. • Activate the connective tissue between U.S. Bank, customer experience, digital, technology, and business line strategy to identify and prioritize product / portfolio opportunities, and establish the product vision, charter and roadmap. • Defines product outcomes and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) to prioritize Features/Epics and breaks down work into actionable steps to facilitate product discovery, design, development and delivery. • Manages the end-to-end product lifecycle and drives the product roadmap leveraging OKRs (Objectives and Key Results). Creates the product in conjunction with agile, experience design, technology and risk partners to achieve business and customer outcomes. In the case of technical products, understands and cares for the technical features, debt reduction and modernization of the technical product with expertise in the technology required of the product. Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills: • Expertise on the critical interdependencies among product model system elements that help and hinder performance; ability to plan and design solutions that synchronize resources to achieve business results using business metrics, key performance indicators, design systems, service blueprints, and reusability. • Ability to anticipate shifting market priorities, internal and external customer needs in a manner that consistently adds value. • Strong customer centricity to implement strategies and techniques used to ensure that customers have a positive experience with the organization's products and services at every touch point. • Knowledge of technical aspects of software products; ability to design, configure and integrate technical aspects of software products. • Knowledge of Agile ways of working, knowledge of processes, tools and techniques for assessing and controlling an organization's exposure to risks of various kinds; ability to apply knowledge of risk management appropriately to diverse situations. • Preferred skills: product PnL, product strategy, vision and planning, product discovery, product development, channel alignment and management, adoption, customer experience research, insight and execution, agile ways of working, go to market and sales channels, performance measurement and optimization, marketing and analytics, customer centricity. title: Product Manager
job_description:
Turn Pricing Into Perfect Matches

  

At Shaadi.com, we don’t just help people find love—we build products that make millions of journeys possible. We’re looking for a sharp, high-energy Product Manager to own our Pricing & Promotions pods, where every experiment, offer, and price point directly shapes growth, conversion, and revenue.
  
If you love decoding user behaviour, running high-impact experiments, and turning data into business wins, this role is your kind of match.

️What You’ll Own

* Own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for pricing, promotions, offers, and monetisation initiatives across Shaadi.com.
* Design and launch pricing models, discounting strategies, subscription offers, and campaign-led promotions that drive conversions without compromising long-term value.
* Use analytics, A/B tests, and user research to identify opportunities, validate hypotheses, and measure impact on revenue, retention, and user experience.
* Partner closely with Tech, Design, Data, Marketing, Finance, and Business teams to ship initiatives end to end.
* Monitor key metrics—conversion, ARPU, revenue, uptake, churn, and margin—and translate insights into clear product decisions.
* Balance user delight with business outcomes: build offers that feel valuable to members while driving sustainable growth.

  

Who We’re Looking For

* 2–4 years of product management experience, ideally in pricing, promotions, growth, monetisation, or B2C product roles.
* Experience at a top consumer-facing organisation is strongly preferred—someone who understands scale, speed, and user-first thinking.
* MBA from a top B-school is preferred.
* High IQ, strong structured thinking, and the ability to simplify complex trade-offs quickly.
* Comfortable with data: funnels, cohorts, experiments, pricing elasticity, and business metrics.
* A builder’s mindset: proactive, ownership-driven, comfortable with ambiguity, and excited to ship fast.

Why Shaadi.com?

* Work on one of India’s most iconic consumer internet brands, with real impact on millions of users.
* Own high-visibility pricing and promotions pods where your decisions move the business.
* Be based in Mumbai, working onsite with product, tech, and business leaders.

We are looking for a highly motivated Associate Product Manager (APM) with 1–3 years of experience in building and managing websites and mobile applications. The ideal candidate will support the end-to-end product lifecycle from requirement gathering to launch, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, design, business, QA, and account management.

You will play a key role in improving user experience, driving feature adoption, and ensuring timely and high-quality product delivery. A keen eye for detail, user empathy, and a strong grasp of digital platforms are essential.

● Translate user needs and business goals into clear feature requirements and user stories ● Work with design and development teams to ensure timely and high-quality execution  
● Conduct user research, usability testing, and competitor benchmarking  
● Monitor product performance and user behavior using Google Analytics  
● Maintain clear product documentation, release notes, and training materials  
● Ensure alignment with business stakeholders and account managers, and provide regular updates on progress

job_description:
Job Title: Product Manager – Nutraceuticals Division

Company name : Vieroots Wellness Solutions Pvt Ltd

Location: Kochi, Kerala

Department: Product Management & R&D

**About Vieroots**

Vieroots is a pioneering health-tech and wellness company specializing in personalized, genomics-driven preventive healthcare. By combining epigenetic lifestyle modifications (EPLIMO) with targeted nutritional supplementation, we empower individuals to optimize their healthspan and prevent lifestyle diseases. We are looking for an entrepreneurial, end-to-end Product Manager to spearhead the entire product lifecycle for our Nutraceuticals Division.

**Role Overview**

The Product Manager – Nutraceuticals will own the vision, strategy, formulation roadmap, launch, and lifecycle management of Vieroots’ nutritional supplement portfolio. You will act as the central bridge between our scientific/genomics team, R&D partners, regulatory affairs, supply chain, and marketing/sales teams—taking concepts from scientific insight to commercially successful, high-efficacy products.

**Key Responsibilities**

\* Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define and execute the multi-year product roadmap for the nutraceuticals division, aligning product launches with Vieroots’ personalized genomics and epigenetic recommendations.

\* End-to-End Product Development: Lead the full product development lifecycle (NPD)—from ideation, market research, and ingredient sourcing to formulation, stability testing, packaging design, and commercial scale-up.

\* Scientific & R&D Collaboration: Partner closely with in-house geneticists, nutritionists, and external R&D labs/contract manufacturers (CDMOs) to develop evidence-based, bioavailable, and differentiated formulations.

\* Regulatory & Quality Compliance: Ensure all formulations, claims, labels, and manufacturing processes strictly comply with FSSAI guidelines and relevant international nutraceutical standards (e.g., GMP, ISO, USFDA norms where applicable).

\* Vendor & Supply Chain Coordination: Identify, evaluate, and onboard contract manufacturers and raw ingredient suppliers; oversee cost optimization, COGS management, and vendor quality audits.

\* Go-To-Market (GTM) & Positioning: Craft compelling product positioning, value propositions, and scientific dossiers; collaborate with marketing, digital, and sales teams to drive product launches, medical/practitioner education, and customer adoption.

\* Lifecycle & P&L Management: Monitor post-launch performance, customer feedback, clinical efficacy data, and unit economics; drive product iterations, line extensions, and SKU rationalization.

**Qualifications & Experience**

\* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Pharmacy (B.Pharm / M.Pharm), Food Technology, Biotechnology, Nutrition, Life Sciences, or a related field. An MBA in Product Management or Marketing is a strong plus.

\* Experience: 2–5 years of experience in product management, new product development (NPD), or brand management within the nutraceutical, dietary supplements, functional foods, or consumer healthcare/pharma industries.

\* Domain Expertise: Proven track record of taking nutraceutical or OTC health products from concept to market launch. Deep familiarity with FSSAI nutraceutical regulations, ingredient bioavailability, and formulation challenges.

\* Analytical & Commercial Acumen: Strong understanding of pricing strategy, COGS, margin optimization, and market trend analysis.

\* Soft Skills: Exceptional cross-functional leadership, project management, and communication skills—capable of translating complex scientific/genomic concepts into clear consumer benefits.

**Preferred Qualifications**

\* Prior experience working in personalized nutrition, preventative healthcare, or direct-to-consumer (D2C) wellness brands.

\* Familiarity with nutrigenomics, epigenetics, or metabolic health supplements.

**What We Offer**

\* Opportunity to shape the product portfolio of a fast-growing, science-first personalized wellness brand.

\* High autonomy and end-to-end ownership across R&D, operations, and commercial strategy.

\* Collaborative, innovation-driven work culture with competitive compensation and growth opportunities.

Pay: ₹45,000.00 - ₹55,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for an Associate Product Manager with 1–2 years of experience who is excited about building user-focused products and solving real customer problems. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Business teams to take ideas from discovery to execution and continuously improve the product experience.

This role is ideal for someone who is analytical, curious, highly execution-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

Location: Vasant Kunj, Delhi - Hybrid

**What you'll do**

*Understand the problem*

* Talk to users regularly. Run interviews, sit in on support and sales calls, watch people use the product, and read the feedback nobody else reads.
* Separate what users ask for from what they actually need, and turn scattered input into a clear, prioritized problem list.
* Bring evidence, not opinions. Every proposal should trace back to something a real user said or did.

*Build and design*

* Turn ideas into clickable prototypes using AI tools like Claude, Lovable, or whatever gets you to a real interaction fastest, so users, stakeholders, engineers, and QA can all experience the thing before it's built.
* Design the experience end to end: the main flow, the empty states, the error messages, the edge cases.
* Use AI to multiply your output. Synthesizing research, building internal tools, analyzing data, testing ideas in an afternoon instead of a sprint.
* Help ship AI-powered features, and think hard about what happens when the model gets it wrong.

*Own delivery*

* Keep a clear, prioritized backlog for your area. Be able to explain why something is next, including what you're not doing and why.
* Write short and plainly: the problem, the user, one success metric, what's in scope and what isn't.
* Work with engineering and QA through backlog grooming, sprint planning, and QA. Answer questions, resolve ambiguity, test the release yourself before it ships.
* Help plan and run launches with the people who need to know: support, sales, marketing, and leadership.

**What we're looking for**

* **A portfolio we can open:** Projects, tools, prototypes, or products you've built.
* **User curiosity:** You open an app and can't help asking why people keep coming back to it, and what you'd steal.
* **AI fluency:** You've gone past basic prompting. You know how to give a model the right context, you've seen where models fail, and you've thought about what to do about it.
* **Taste:** Shown two versions of a screen, you can say which is better and explain why in terms of the user. You notice layout, hierarchy, spacing, and what a screen does when it's empty or broken.
* **Comfort with data:** You can pull numbers out of a sheet or a dashboard, spot when something looks off, and back a conclusion with them.
* **Clear thinking under ambiguity:** You can break a vague problem into something testable.
* **Strong communication:** You can explain a decision to an engineer, a designer, and a business stakeholder without changing the substance.
* **Attention to detail:** In the product, and in your own work.

**Nice to have**

* You've written an eval, or tuned LLM model settings and can say what changed.
* Fluency in Figma, or formal design training.
* Hands-on time with an analytics tool (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Metabase, GA).
* A side project with real users you didn't have to recruit.
* Interest in education, careers, or working with students.

No MBA required. No prior PM title required. If you're short on experience, product depth and the drive to build make up for it. What matters is what you've built.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Company Description**

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**

Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost-to-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise-grade yet easy-to-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.

***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.***

 **Job Description**

Take Ownership: Own and build modules for sustained differentiation and growth. Develop deep domain expertise and understand trends in the market. The role requires you to plan, build, release, and measure success for an end to end modules.

Be a Customer Champion: Develop a sense of empathy with our customer base to build an understanding of various problems. The role is also a bridge between the customer and the engineering teams to ensure focus on solving customer needs & delivering continuous value. Practice Craftsmanship: Learn and Practice product craft. Create solutions with delightful user experiences and find the balance between solving the customer problem and shipping the right product solution. We take pride in releasing the smallest of features while iterating and shipping regularly.

Play as One Team: The role needs you to communicate clearly to various stakeholders of Product development, Engineering, Marketing, Sales & Leadership teams and work together to bring your vision to life.

Act with Urgency: Breakdown complex problems to phases to help the team make incremental progress while still keeping the bigger picture intact. You’d evangelize the vision and ensure maximum customer value is achieved with the appropriate amount of work.

 **Qualifications**

* 8+ years of working in global/cross-functional software teams in a software product company. SaaS experience is preferred as you’d settle right in.
* Experience in building SaaS products is a plus
* Being empathetic and having a strong listening ability to understand the other person - may it be a customer or a stakeholder.
* Ability to arrive at intuitive & uncomplicated solutions from concept to scale by leveraging AI.
* Ability to communicate complex concepts/customer problems in a simple way to internal & external stakeholders.
* A track record of making day-to-day data-driven decisions in a fast-evolving environment while keeping an eye on the overall vision.
* Having worked in a mode of structured experimentation - measuring and iterating on problems from time to time to achieve product goals.

 **Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

Be a Customer Champion: Develop a sense of empathy with our customer base to build an understanding of various problems. The role is also a bridge between the customer and the engineering teams to ensure focus on solving customer needs & delivering continuous value. Practice Craftsmanship: Learn and Practice product craft. Create solutions with delightful user experiences and find the balance between solving the customer problem and shipping the right product solution. We take pride in releasing the smallest of features while iterating and shipping regularly.

Play as One Team: The role needs you to communicate clearly to various stakeholders of Product development, Engineering, Marketing, Sales & Leadership teams and work together to bring your vision to life.

Act with Urgency: Breakdown complex problems to phases to help the team make incremental progress while still keeping the bigger picture intact. You’d evangelize the vision and ensure maximum customer value is achieved with the appropriate amount of work.

 **Qualifications**

* 8+ years of working in global/cross-functional software teams in a software product company. SaaS experience is preferred as you’d settle right in.
* Experience in building SaaS products is a plus
* Being empathetic and having a strong listening ability to understand the other person - may it be a customer or a stakeholder.
* Ability to arrive at intuitive & uncomplicated solutions from concept to scale by leveraging AI.
* Ability to communicate complex concepts/customer problems in a simple way to internal & external stakeholders.
* A track record of making day-to-day data-driven decisions in a fast-evolving environment while keeping an eye on the overall vision.
* Having worked in a mode of structured experimentation - measuring and iterating on problems from time to time to achieve product goals.

 **Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

title: Product Manager - Pharma PMT
job_description:
You will be responsible for guiding a drug or healthcare product through its lifecycle, with a primary focus on market research, pipeline strategy, pre-launch preparation, and commercial rollout.

* Inbound Marketing & Research: Conduct competitive intelligence, patient opportunity analysis, market sizing, and customer/KOL (Key Opinion Leader) mapping.
* Pre-Launch & Strategy Formulation: Build the value proposition, product positioning, pricing guidance, and lifecycle phase plans (pre-launch, launch, and post-launch).
* Promotional & Campaign Development: Create scientific and promotional materials—such as visual aids, LBLs (leave-behind literature), digital campaigns, websites, and CME (Continuing Medical Education) programs.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with R&D, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Sales/PMT (Product Management Team), and Supply Chain teams to align clinical goals with market demand.
* Sales Force Empowerment: Train field forces and sales representatives on scientific communication, product USPs (Unique Selling Propositions), and promotional tactics.
* P&L & Forecasting: Manage product budgets, sales forecasting, target setting, and post-launch KPI monitoring.

Qualifications & Requirements

* Education: B.Pharm / B.Sc (Life Sciences) combined with an MBA in Marketing.
* Experience: Typically ranges from 3 to 8+ years in pharma marketing/brand management (or moving from field sales/MR to head office PMT roles).
* Key Skills: Scientific acumen, strategic thinking, data-driven market analysis, stakeholder management, and strong cross-functional leadership.

Pay: ₹785,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Experience:

* Product development: 5 years (Preferred)

Location:

* Sangli, Maharashtra (Preferred)

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager Pharma Industry
job_description:
Company: Curavea Pharma Pvt. Ltd.

Department: Product Management

Designation: Product Manager

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Product Manager for our pharmaceutical business. The candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing product strategies, managing product portfolios, supporting sales and marketing activities, and driving brand growth in the market.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product & Brand Management

* Manage the company's pharmaceutical product portfolio.
* Develop brand strategies to increase product sales and market share.
* Plan and execute new product launches.
* Identify opportunities for existing product growth.

2. Market Research & Analysis

* Conduct market research and competitor analysis.
* Monitor competitor brands, pricing, products and promotional activities.
* Identify market trends and new business opportunities.
* Analyse product performance and sales reports.

3. Sales & Marketing Support

* Develop marketing strategies and promotional plans for pharmaceutical products.
* Prepare visual aids, product presentations, product literature and promotional materials.
* Coordinate with RSMs, DSMs and the sales team to improve product performance.
* Provide product knowledge and scientific training to the sales team.
* Develop strategies for doctor engagement and prescription generation.

4. New Product Development

* Identify potential molecules and therapeutic segments for new product launches.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams for product development and launch planning.
* Study product positioning, pricing and market potential.

5. Coordination & Reporting

* Work closely with the sales, marketing and management teams.
* Track monthly product-wise sales and brand performance.
* Prepare monthly and quarterly product performance reports.
* Recommend corrective actions to improve sales and brand visibility.

Required Qualifications

* B.Pharm / M.Pharm / B.Sc. / M.Sc. (Life Sciences).
* MBA in Marketing will be an added advantage.
* Good understanding of the pharmaceutical industry and product management.

Experience

* 3–6 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Experience in pharmaceutical product management or brand management preferred.
* Experience in handling product portfolios, marketing strategies and sales team coordination.

Required Skills

* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Market research and analytical skills.
* Understanding of pharmaceutical products and therapeutic segments.
* Strategic thinking and planning.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint.
* Ability to coordinate with cross-functional teams.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Product-wise sales growth.
* New product launch performance.
* Market share and brand growth.
* Promotional strategy effectiveness.
* Sales team product knowledge and training.
* Achievement of product-wise business targets.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Lead Digital Product Manager
job_description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Digital Product Manager.

This role sits at the core of CIB’s AI transformation agenda, shaping the roadmap, governance, implementation, and scaling of next‑generation AI/GenAI capabilities across business lines. You will drive strategic assessments, integrate AI solutions into key workflows, ensure risk‑aligned delivery, and partner closely with senior leadership to execute high‑impact innovation initiatives.

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead the development and execution of complex digital business plans, programs and initiatives which have impact across the enterprise with broad impact
* Act as key participant in large-scale planning
* Review and analyze complex digital strategy for product/functionality/experience area
* Influence digital strategy for the business line requiring in-depth evaluation of multiple factors including intangibles or unprecedented factors
* Make decisions in digital strategy for product/functionality/experience area requiring strong understanding of the business, policies, procedures and/or compliance requirements
* Lead a broad team of digital professionals to meet deliverables and drive new initiatives
* Strategically collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues and mid-level to senior managers to resolve issues and achieve goals
* Potentially lead projects, teams or serve as a peer mentor

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of digital product management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience in **transformation, product management, business analysis, business execution, and AI solution delivery**
* Deep knowledge of **Corporate & Investment Banking** products, workflows, and asset classes.
* Hands-on experience in **AI/GenAI** solution development and enterprise implementation.
* Strong proficiency with modern AI stacks (Lang Chain, Lang Graph, MCP), GenAI lifecycle processes, and model optimization techniques.
* Experience with **agentic AI**, workflow automation, document intelligence, and intelligent routing.
* Ability to operate across complex organizational structures with excellent communication and stakeholder‑management skills.
* Proven leadership experience, including team guidance, decision‑making, and strategic problem‑solving. Skilled in defining target‑state blueprints and actionable roadmaps.

**Job Expectations**

Ability to manage multiple high‑complexity initiatives with significant cross‑functional impact. Strong analytical, communication, and documentation skills (JIRA, Confluence).Comfortable driving change and influencing senior stakeholders in a dynamic, evolving transformation environment.

**AI & Innovation Delivery**

Lead and execute AI/GenAI initiatives aligned with CIB strategic priorities, from idea validation to deployment. Integrate AI solutions across key CIB journeys—Client, Vendor, Market, Lending—to improve efficiency, decisioning, and servicing experiences.

**Strategy, Governance & Execution**

Conduct strategic reviews, evaluate performance, and solve complex business challenges with structured frameworks and creative problem‑solving. Define and implement processes, procedures, success metrics, and lifecycle standards for AI/ML and agentic workflows.Ensure compliance with CIB and enterprise methodologies, AI governance, AIRR controls, and risk frameworks.

**Program & Stakeholder Leadership**

Lead end‑to‑end program management for high‑visibility innovation initiatives, including scope definition, execution planning, resource management, and stakeholder alignment. Collaborate with cross‑functional leaders across Technology, Product, Business Execution, Risk, and Data to drive delivery and manage dependencies.Mentor and guide junior staff across Strategy & Execution and Innovation teams.

**AI Architecture & Technical Understanding**

Apply practical understanding of LLM workflows, chunking, RAG, hallucination mitigation, vectorization, and prompt engineering. Utilize modern AI tooling (LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol) to support scalable, context-aware AI solutions. Partner with technical teams on cloud, data, integration design, document intelligence, and agentic orchestration.

**Posting End Date:**

19 Nov 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

**Applicants with Disabilities**

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

**Drug and Alcohol Policy**

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

**Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:**

a. Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.

b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

c. Please be prepared to provide accurate information and supporting documentation in connection with any lawful employment and education verification conducted by Wells Fargo.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager II
job_description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**About Tekion**  
  
Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform. Our platform spans the Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, the Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises, and the Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform, using cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to bring together vehicle manufacturers, dealerships, and consumers. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia, and Europe.
  
  
**About the Role**
  
  
Tekion connects dealerships - the businesses that sell and service vehicles - with the automakers that build those vehicles, such as General Motors, Honda, or Ford. Across the industry these automakers are referred to as OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers). The software on each side needs to exchange information automatically and reliably: vehicle orders, inventory, repair records, customer details, and much more. The software that makes this exchange happen is called integration. We are seeking a driven, technically curious Product Manager I to join our Integrations team. You will take ownership of one integration pattern - a family of similar integrations that share the same shape (for example, all the integrations that send vehicle service and repair data to automakers). Your mission is to make every integration in that family measurably healthy and best-in-class, shift more of its delivery from manual building to AI-assisted building, and make sure dealerships actually adopt and benefit from it. This is a hands-on role for an early-career product manager who is comfortable with technical concepts, motivated by measurable outcomes, and excited to help modernize how a decades-old industry connects its software. job_description:
**Position Type :**

Full time

**Type Of Hire :**

Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)

**Principal Technical Product Manager, Agentic AI Platform**

**Location:** Bangalore, India
  
**Function:** Enterprise AI & Data Platforms

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a **Principal Technical Product Manager** to drive the **enablement and enterprise adoption of our Agentic AI Platform**.

You will own the end-to-end experience that enables engineering teams to **discover, onboard, build, migrate and run AI applications and agents at scale**. Working across Platform Engineering, Architecture, Security and product teams, you will translate developer needs and adoption barriers into scalable platform capabilities.

**Your mission: Make our Agentic AI Platform the easiest, safest and most reliable way to build and operate AI across the enterprise.**

**What You'll Do**

* Own the **platform adoption strategy and developer experience**, from onboarding through production.
* Create simple, self-service **onboarding, migration and developer journeys**.
* Partner with engineering teams to identify adoption blockers and convert them into prioritized platform capabilities.
* Shape the roadmap across **AI Gateway, agent frameworks, MCP, model services, identity, APIs/SDKs, observability and deployment**.
* Drive migration of existing AI workloads onto common enterprise platform capabilities.
* Establish clear **production-readiness, reliability, support and operational standards**.
* Use platform telemetry and developer feedback to measure adoption and continuously improve the experience.
* Embed **security, risk and responsible-AI controls** into reusable platform patterns.

**What We're Looking For**

* **15+ years** in technical product management, platform product management or comparable technology leadership.
* Experience scaling a **developer, cloud, API, ML or AI platform** to enterprise adoption.
* Strong technical understanding of **LLMs, agentic AI, MCP, APIs/SDKs, Kubernetes, cloud, identity, RAG, observability and CI/CD**.
* Experience with ecosystems such as **Azure AI/Azure OpenAI, AWS, GitHub, Anthropic Claude** or similar technologies.
* Ability to work deeply with engineers and architects while translating technical complexity into clear product priorities.
* Proven ability to drive outcomes across multiple engineering and business organizations.

**The impact you’ll make**

As Principal Technical Product Manager, you will help teams onboard faster, use more self-service capabilities and move more AI solutions into production. Your work will remove developer blockers, improve platform reliability and increase the reuse of common capabilities. You will turn solutions for individual teams into scalable platform features that benefit teams across the enterprise.

**What we offer you**

Ready to build what's next? At FIS, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, contribute your ideas, and help create technology that powers the global economy.

Our benefits include:

* Opportunities to innovate in fintech
* Tools for personal and professional growth
* Internal career growth opportunities
* Inclusive and diverse work environment
* Resources to invest in your community

**Privacy Statement**

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

**Sourcing Model**

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

job_description:
Role Description:

**About the team**
------------------

FinTech is an ever-changing, complex, competitive, and extremely exciting industry. More than ever before, in order to accomplish Booking.com's mission ("making it easier for everyone to experience the world"), we need to offer world-class payment experiences and financial products on both sides of our marketplace. Do you want to play a part in that journey?

Join us in Bangalore as a Product Manager on the Partner Master Data track within FinTech Foundations, and help us build the single source of truth for Financial Partner Master Data (FPMD) that powers onboarding, payouts, invoicing, and compliance across every Booking Holdings brand.

**About the role**
------------------

Join the Partner Master Data team within FinTech Foundations and help build a trusted source of partner and property data used across Booking Holdings. This foundation supports critical experiences and operations—including partner onboarding, payouts, invoicing and compliance. You’ll own one or more product areas, working within the track’s broader strategy and with guidance from senior product leaders.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Own the roadmap and delivery for your product area, turning business and compliance needs into clear requirements and a prioritized backlog.
* Work with stakeholders to map how partner data is captured, governed and used across upstream and downstream systems.
* Improve the quality of critical data by defining and tracking measures such as completeness, validity, consistency and timeliness, and partnering on remediation.
* Identify risks and dependencies early—including data ownership across teams and brands—and work with Engineering and partners to address them.
* Keep stakeholders informed on progress, decisions, risks and asks; represent your area in planning and governance forums.
* Support clear data ownership practices, including stewardship and lineage, and contribute to hiring and onboarding when needed.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* 4+ years of product management experience, ideally in payments, financial products or master/reference data.
* Experience taking product features from discovery through delivery, particularly in complex or fragmented environments.
* The ability to translate business, tax or compliance needs into clear, sequenced product requirements.
* Strong data fluency: you can define success measures, work with analytics or SQL, interpret data-quality signals and make evidence-based decisions.
* A practical understanding of technical systems and data flows, such as pipelines and large-scale platforms.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build relationships across teams and business units.

Familiarity with master data management—such as golden records, data lineage, validation and governance—is useful. Experience with partner or customer data, tax or regulatory products, or B2B FinTech is a plus. You’ll also bring a thoughtful perspective on how AI may shape data, compliance and financial operations.

job_description:
We are looking for a technically competent and business-oriented Keysight EDA Product Manager responsible for driving sales growth, market development, product positioning, and customer engagement for Keysight Electronic Design Automation solutions.

The role involves identifying new business opportunities, developing strategic accounts, working closely with Keysight OEM teams, supporting technical sales activities, and achieving revenue targets across key industries.

  

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

* **Product Management & Business Development**

* Drive sales and revenue growth for Keysight EDA solutions.
* Develop annual business plans, revenue targets, and product growth strategies.
* Identify new customers and emerging markets for RF, microwave, wireless, and semiconductor design solutions.
* Build and manage sales pipelines and forecast opportunities.
* Identify competitive replacement opportunities involving Cadence, Ansys, and other EDA solutions.
  

* **Sales & Key Account Management**

* Develop relationships with R&D heads, RF design engineers, technical directors, and engineering leadership.
* Manage strategic accounts across defence, aerospace, space, telecommunications, semiconductor, automotive, and research organizations.
* Conduct customer meetings, product presentations, and solution discussions.
* Work with application engineers to arrange product demonstrations, evaluations, and proof-of-concept activities.
  

* **OEM Coordination & Business Planning**

* Work closely with Keysight product and regional teams.
* Conduct business planning meetings.
* Coordinate technical support, customer evaluations, and product training.
* Prepare quarterly business reviews and account development plans.
* Identify opportunities for joint customer visits and marketing initiatives.
  

* **Marketing & Demand Generation**

* Organize technical workshops, webinars, seminars, and industry events.
* Generate qualified leads through targeted prospecting campaigns.
* Collaborate with marketing teams on product positioning and campaigns.
* Track market trends, customer requirements, and competitor activities.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Telecommunications, or a related engineering discipline.
* 5–10 years of experience in EDA software technical sales, product management, or business development.
* Understanding of RF/microwave engineering, wireless communications, radar, semiconductor design, and simulation workflows.
* Familiarity with Keysight ADS, SystemVue, EMPro, or equivalent EDA software is advantageous.
* Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and customer relationship management skills.
* Ability to manage account planning, and OEM relationships.
* Willingness to travel for customer meetings and business development.

**Job Category:** Product Manager – Keysight EDA Solutions

**Job Type:** Full Time

**Job Location:** Bangalore

**Experience:** 5 To 10 Years

**Education:** B.E/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech in Electrical Electrical and Electronics Engineering Electronics and Communication Engineering
