job_description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Summary:  
The Sr. Product Manager is responsible for directing product strategy from conception and definition through implementation. This role identifies new business and market opportunities and creates appropriate business plans. Responsibilities include determining the market for the product, understanding marketplace requirements, and ensuring consistency of new products with the organization’s image and objectives. The Sr. Product Manager functions as a central resource, interacting with systems, marketing, and sales during the product development stage, and formulates and executes long-term plans for cost and profit control. The role also promotes the use of new technologies and industry-leading trends.  
  
All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.  
  
Key Responsibilities:

* Direct product strategy from conception through implementation.
* Identify new business and market opportunities and develop business plans.
* Determine product market requirements and ensure alignment with organizational objectives.
* Serve as a central resource interacting with systems, marketing, and sales during product development.
* Formulate and execute long-term plans for cost and profit control.
* Promote adoption of new technologies and industry-leading trends.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* 8 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD.
* Experience in roles such as product manager, product owner, business process analyst, or sales operations.
* Experience in applying Agile principles across design, development, testing, and product management.
* Experience in developing software capabilities to support sales, service, or customer relationship management functions.
* Experience in multi-tasking, organizing, managing, and implementing complex projects directly or through supervision.
* Experience in cross-functional collaboration with systems, marketing, and sales teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

title: Staff Product Manager, Time & Attendance
job_description:
**Overview**
------------

**Overview**

Small businesses drive the global economy. In the US, SMBs employ 60% of the labor force and create 80% of new jobs. However, the stakes are high, as 1 in 2 businesses will fail to survive within their first five years. In an environment where time is money, precise time tracking for payroll, invoicing, and project management is the critical lever for maintaining profitability and growing the business.

Within QuickBooks, our Workforce platform fuels productivity for growing teams — from time tracking and scheduling to project management and field operations. With 30M+ employees in the QuickBooks ecosystem and 18M paid through Workforce Solutions, we are building the essential tools that empower frontline teams and help businesses turn time into money.

**Opportunity**

We are seeking a Staff Product Manager to lead the verticalization of QuickBooks Time. You’ll make our time tracking platform the system of record for hours, labor cost, and payroll in the industries where labor is the highest cost, starting with construction and field services. Time is the source of hours for the entire QuickBooks ecosystem. Customers use the hours their teams track to run payroll, bill for their work, and understand whether each job is making money, and the mid-market businesses we serve need all three to work together without spreadsheets or re-entry.

This is a high-ownership role. You will own three connected areas end to end: time to payroll, so approved hours, overtime, and pay items flow into QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automagically; job costing, so every hour tracked produces labor cost estimates against projects and budgets before payroll runs and accurate actuals after it; and worker time tracking across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers track their time. You will build on Time 2.0, our rebuilt time platform that now lives inside QuickBooks Online, and extend it so that serving a new industry is mostly configuration rather than new code.

We need a scrappy, customer-obsessed product leader who leads through influence. Someone who navigates dependencies across Payroll, Projects, Mid-Market, and Payments, earns the trust and confidence of our customers and accountants, and ships experiences that delight both the worker clocking in on a job site and the admin who approves time and runs payroll.

**Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities**

* **Vertical Strategy.** Own the multi-year roadmap for verticalizing QuickBooks Time, starting with construction and field services. Translate how each industry runs its labor (jobs, cost codes, phases, and certified payroll on a construction site; jobs, visits, and dispatch in field services) into shared platform concepts and configurable experiences, so that each new vertical is mostly configuration rather than new code. Decide what we build, what we configure, and where partner integrations fill the gap.
* **Time to Payroll.** Own the flow of hours from clock-in to paycheck. Make approved time, overtime and break policies, and pay items land in QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automatically, with no exports, syncs, or re-entry, and make approvals fast and trustworthy for a mid-market company with hundreds of employees.
* **Job Costing: Estimates and Actuals.** Deliver real-time labor costing that owners, project managers, and accountants trust. Partner with Projects, Payroll, and Accounting so that time is the single source of hours for payroll, invoicing, and profitability reporting.
* **Worker Time Tracking.** Own how workers track time across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers already track their hours. Deliver one consistent, reliable experience for clocking in and out, breaks, schedules, geofencing, and job and task selection that holds up on a job site with poor connectivity and for crews whose first language is not English, and complete the migration of workers off legacy TSheets surfaces onto the new platform.
* **Commercial Impact.** Own the metrics for your area: Time adoption within Workforce Premium and Elite offerings, attached in mid-market and industry editions. Plus worker engagement across web, kiosk, and mobile. Use data and customer evidence to prioritize, measure what ships, and make Time and real-time job costing a central part of how QuickBooks is sold to construction and field services customers, a market where competitors generate $150M+ ARR.
* **Operational Velocity.** Run the end-to-end product lifecycle for your area: write crisp requirements, pressure-test designs, manage edge cases, and drive alignment across engineering, design, data, go-to-market, and customer success teams in the US and India. You lead through influence rather than authority, and you are fluent in AI-native tools like Claude and Cursor, using them to move faster from insight to shipped product.
* **Customer Empathy.** Be the voice of the business owner, the payroll admin, and the frontline worker. Spend time with customers on their job sites and with the accountants who recommend HCM products to their clients, and make sure every feature removes a real pain point in how they bid, schedule, track, pay, and get paid.

**Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

* **A Product Leader.** 8+ years of product management craft, including ownership of a complex, multi-team product area as a senior individual contributor. You have a proven track record of building and scaling customer-facing products in HCM, workforce management, construction or field service software, or fintech.
* **Strategic & Influential.** You possess strong executive presence, translating market and customer insight into a strategy and roadmap that align senior stakeholders and technical teams. You make bold bets and bring partner teams along without direct authority.
* **Domain Depth.** You understand how labor-intensive businesses run: how hours become payroll, how time, cost rates, and pay types become job costs, and how estimates compare to actuals. Experience with payroll, time and attendance, job costing, or construction and field service workflows is a strong advantage.
* **A Proven Growth Driver.** You have a track record of spearheading complex initiatives that deliver measurable business growth. You understand the levers of adoption, attach, ARPC, and retention, and you use them to prioritize and to drive P&L growth.
* **An Ambitious Problem Solver.** You proactively anticipate customer and stakeholder needs, thrive in ambiguity and turn complex, messy friction into clear roadmaps. You are scrappy and effective at managing a portfolio of bets across the lifecycle, from 0-1 innovations to products at scale. You know when to push forward and when to pivot based on evidence and stakeholder feedback.
* **Customer Obsessed & Analytical.** You possess deep empathy for small and mid-market business operations and frontline workforce challenges. You combine this heart with rigorous analytical aptitude, storytelling with data to prioritize investments.
* **Technical Fluency.** You demonstrate strong product judgment and comfort engaging across technical topics to build reliable web, mobile, and kiosk products on a shared platform, including APIs, data models, and integrations with payroll and accounting systems. Experience with agentic AI, payment systems, or HCM platforms is an advantage.
* **Education.** BA or BS degree is required, and an MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Powering the agentic revolution in travel.** Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

**Role Overview**  
  
**As part of the Sabre Payments team, this Senior Product Manager will lead the definition, execution, and delivery of strategic payment initiatives critical to scaling Sabre’s global business. Operating at the core intersection of travel and modern financial technology, the role bridges commercial strategy and technical engineering to build robust, scalable payment capabilities. The successful candidate will resolve complex product challenges creatively to deliver high-impact solutions for our project teams, broader department, and travel partners. In doing so, this position directly advances Sabre’s overarching strategic vision of powering next-generation travel retailing and seamless transaction workflows worldwide.**

  

**2. What THIS ROLE Will Do**

* **Product Strategy & Requirement Translation:** Serve as the strategic bridge between business stakeholders and engineering, translating high-level business goals into actionable functional specifications, technical requirements, and detailed user stories.
* **End-to-End Delivery & Execution:** Own and drive the end-to-end product delivery lifecycle across cross-functional engineering and design teams, ensuring features are delivered on schedule and directly impact the success of the project team, department, and clients.
* **Creative Problem-Solving & Technical Alignment:** Resolve a wide range of complex product and integration challenges through creative, scalable technical solutions, maintaining high quality and operational reliability.
* **Stakeholder Influence & Cross-Functional Networking:** Proactively network and collaborate with senior internal teams (engineering, architecture, commercial) and external partners/vendors within your domain of expertise to align priorities and clear project roadmaps.
* **Team Guidance & Best Practices:** Act as a fully qualified domain practitioner, mentoring junior product associates or team members on product management best practices, backlog grooming, and Agile methodologies where applicable.

  

**3. What THIS ROLE Requires**

* **Relevant Experience:** 5 years of dedicated product management experience partnering directly with engineering teams to define, build, and deliver customer-facing or platform products and capabilities.
* **Technical & Analytical Acumen:** Strong experience decomposing complex workflows into clear user stories, API/technical requirements, acceptance criteria, and roadmap milestones within Agile/Scrum environments.
* **Proven Delivery & Creative Problem Solving:** Demonstrated track record of independently resolving multifaceted product challenges in creative ways to drive measurable project and business outcomes.
* **Stakeholder & Influence Skills:** Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to network, build alignment, and present effectively across both senior technical leadership and commercial stakeholders.
* **Domain Knowledge (Preferred):** Prior domain experience in digital payments, fintech gateways/processing, or the travel technology ecosystem is a strong plus

  

**4. Why Join Us**

* **Lead at the Intersection of Travel & Fintech:** Directly contribute to architecting and scaling a high-growth travel fintech ecosystem that processes transactions across the global travel marketplace.
* **Innovation & Cutting-Edge Tech:** Join Sabre at the forefront of AI-driven transformation, leveraging modern platforms and intelligent automation to reshape how the world travels and transacts.
* **Autonomous Impact & Visibility:** Step into a "fully qualified" L10 role with meaningful ownership over strategic initiatives, where your solutions have a direct line of sight to client success and departmental growth.
* **Collaborative Culture & Growth:** Work within a collaborative, globally distributed team that champions knowledge sharing, continuous mentorship, and clear pathways for senior product leadership advancement.

  

We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses.

Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

title: PRODUCT MANAGER III
job_description:
TE Connectivity's Product Management Teams manage all aspects of a product, from driving new product development to manufacturing to marketing. They are responsible for overall product strategy, business leadership and capacity plans in order to meet sales and profit targets.

**Responsibilties**
-------------------

**Market Sensing & Strategy Development:**
  

* Research market trends, demand drivers, customer needs, industry trends, and competitive landscape
* Conduct competitive analysis and benchmarking
* Conduct market segmentation exercises to define segment specific value propositions to beat competition.
* Develop product roadmaps that aligns with business strategy
* Design go to market strategy
* Work with R&D and operations in the development of new products to meet current and future customer requirements

**Develop Business Plan**
  

* Define resource requirements necessary to execute the product roadmap
* Work cross functionally to achieve sales, technology and operations strategies and goals, in line with financial goals.
* Establish pricing strategy
* Develop the annual operating plan (Sales and gross margin)

**Execution – New Product Development & Launch**
  

* Be the opportunity champion for development projects
* Attend customer meetings in support of winning new business
* Plans product launches, including the development of marketing and sales plans
* Gather product specification and product attribute information for the development of marketing collateral, including e-catalog

**Execution – Post Launch Product Management**
  

* Manage the P&L (sales and gross margin) for the assigned portfolio
* Deliver sustained profitable growth
* Enable sales to promote product line via training and the development of collateral materials that help articulate the value proposition
* Manage special price requests
* Track progress to the business plan and facilitate resolution to gaps
* Be the champion for resolution of product issues (e.g., quality, delivery, etc.

**Qualification**
-----------------

* 7 years of product management, development engineering or field application engineering experience
* 4-year technical degree required, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering degree preferred

* Relevant product or industry experience desired

**Additional Qualification**
----------------------------

* Strong business acumen with an ability to understand technically complex concepts
* Creative and innovative thinker
* Proven ability to multi-task and drive results in a dynamic, high paced environment
* Strong interpersonal, planning, organization, and teamwork skills
* Ability to influence cross functional teams and to build strong relationships both internally and externally

* Comfortable presenting complex concepts in a group setting

* Ability to travel domestically and internationally between 10%-25%

**Competencies**
----------------

Values: Integrity, Accountability, Inclusion, Innovation, Teamwork

**ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY**

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

  

**WHAT TE CONNECTIVITY OFFERS:**
  
We are pleased to offer you an exciting total package that can also be flexibly adapted to changing life situations - the well-being of our employees is our top priority!

* Competitive Salary Package
* Performance-Based Bonus Plans
* Health and Wellness Incentives
* Employee Stock Purchase Program
* Community Outreach Programs / Charity Events
* Employee Resource Group

  

**IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
  
TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity **never requests payment or fees** from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come **only from** **actual** **email addresses ending in @te.com**. If you receive any suspicious communications, we strongly advise you not to engage or provide any personal information, and to report the incident to your local authorities.

Across our global sites and business units, we put together packages of benefits that are either supported by TE itself or provided by external service providers. In principle, the benefits offered can vary from site to site.

Bangalore, Karnātaka 560037
  
India

Job Country: India

State/Province: Karnātaka

Travel Required: 10% to 25%

job_description:
**Role:** Product Manager - IT
  
  
**About Us:** Scrubsy is India's #1 foam-based household cleaner – trusted by thousands of families for kitchen, bathroom, footwear, and all-purpose cleaning. We're a fast growing D2C brand under BoldChem Science Pvt. Ltd., scaling rapidly across Amazon, our own website, and quick commerce platforms. We are a funded organization. We move fast, we care deeply about quality, and we're building the team that is passionate!
  
  
**Brief:** We're looking for a Product Manager - IT to own the discovery, design, and delivery of internal tools and systems that make the business run more efficiently. This role sits between business teams and engineering identifying manual or inefficient processes, defining requirements, and driving internal products from concept through adoption.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
Identify manual, inefficient, or error-prone internal processes across teams and translate them into internal tool or automation opportunities
  
Own the product lifecycle for internal tools discovery, PRDs/requirement documents, prioritization, execution, and adoption tracking
  
Define Statements of Work (SOWs), Minimum Viable Products (MVPs), and success metrics for internal tooling initiatives
  
Partner closely with teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications and manage delivery timelines
  
Drive cross-functional alignment across stakeholders to scope and prioritize process-improvement projects
  
Track and report measurable impact of shipped tools
  
Manage risks, timelines, and resourcing for internal product initiatives; proactively flag scope or timeline changes to stakeholders
  
Continuously gather feedback and identify the next set of improvement opportunities
  
Maintain documentation, status reporting, and dashboards
  
  
What We Are Looking For
  
  
Mandatory Requirement
  
  
4+ years of experience in Product Management or a closely related role
  
Proven track record of building or managing internal tools, automation, or process-
  
improvement initiatives with measurable business impact
  
Demonstrated experience writing PRDs, SOWs, or detailed requirement documents and driving them through to delivery
  
Strong cross-functional stakeholder management experience
  
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, or a related field
  
  
Additional Requirement
  
  
Experience in e-commerce, D2C, or consumer tech product management
  
Exposure to AI/ML-driven features
  
Working knowledge of tools such as JIRA, SQL, Power BI/Google Analytics, or similar product/data tooling
  
  
Who You Are
  
  

* Proactive – you spot inefficiencies before they become problems and solve them
* Ownership Driven – you take complete ownership of your products, from identifying the problems to driving execution and adoption
* Detail Oriented – you pay attention to the details that can make or break a product, process, or user experience
* Curious – you constantly ask Why, explore better ways of working, and look for opportunities to automate and improve

**. Skillset Required:** Product Management, Internal tools, Automation, Process improvement, Business impact measurement, PRD writing, Statement of Work (SOW) writing, Requirement documentation, Cross-functional stakeholder management, E-commerce product management, D2C product management, Consumer tech product management, AI/ML-driven features, JIRA, SQL, Power BI, Google Analytics, Data tooling, Proactive problem solving, Product ownership, Attention to detail, Process automation

BE/BTech/MCA or any relevant degree with a background in consumer internet products

4-6 years’ experience delivering highly successful and innovative products with your fingerprints all over them -you’re extremely proud of what you’ve accomplished.

You carry the optimum blend of business, creativity (UI/UX) and technology.

You are hands-on and go-getter to build & enhance your product through teamwork.

You are on a constant drive to expand the product through research & stitching new partnerships.

You’re expected to be a polymath who can bring ideas and analogies from different domains to solve a problem. You should be able to understand third or fourth level metrics.

Stellar design instincts and product taste

Finger-tippiness with data: you just go get the data you need with no muss/fuss and can whip it into an insightful story with no help. You know how to leverage data to make decisions without getting stuck in analysis paralysis.

Grittiness: You never hesitate to roll up your sleeves and tackle something hands-on, you persevere when others fall away.

Own product charter & build Product Roadmap

Develop Wireframe & PRD for new features / services.

Understand Digital Technologies involved in responsive web development & API Integrations.

Hands-on experience on various product development and product management tools including but limited to Jira / Confluence / Miro / Google Analytics / Martech / CRM.

Candidates from a travel & accommodation (Market place, Property Management System and Channel Manager) background will be preferred.

Should have experience in managing B2C/B2B products - responsive web & mobile app(Android/iOS) user Interfaces.

Most importantly, you should be fun to work with.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Manage Responsive Web,Mobile App, CRM, Property Management System, and all other major building blocks.

Driving Lead & Conversion Growth - Visitor to Lead & Lead to Successful Closure through UX, Research, Data driven Features and meticulous execution.

Break silos, drive wow experiences and create efficiencies through digital adoptions.

You’ll be responsible for absorbing all the complexities of the domain and making simple, elegant and polished products for our users. You’ll have to learn and unlearn fast across domains.

You’ll be working closely with the engineers, designers and analysts and marketing team who care deeply about their product. You should be able to quickly build rapport with them. Persuasiveness is more valued here than authority.

You’ll be owning product charters and would be responsible for every delivery. Your product charter will change as we evolve.

You should be able to understand macro changes in the market and identify potential opportunities and risks. You should be able to plan features in smaller sprints while keeping an eye on the larger vision.

You’ll be extremely meticulous and prudent in testing every feature that goes out. We ship high quality software.

You’ll be the internal evangelist of the product who will go to everyone and help them understand why we should build a feature.

**Soft Skills:**

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines.

Team player who can adapt to new and evolving processes.

title: Product Manager SSC & EO
job_description:
Years of Experience: 12–15 Years

Location: Noida

Work from Office

##### **Role Purpose**

Own the assigned product portfolio from market discovery and emerging product
  
identification through specification finalisation, development, certification, launch
  
and lifecycle management. Turn market insights into differentiated products and bring
  
clear recommendations to management on product priorities, investment and
  
sourcing.

##### **Key responsibilities**

**Market research and stakeholder engagement:**

* Conduct structured market surveys, customer interviews and site visits to identify
    
  unmet needs, buying criteria and deployment challenges.
* Engage customers to understand operational needs, consultants to understand
    
  specification and compliance expectations, and Master System Integrators (MSIs)
    
  to assess integration and deployment requirements.
* Work with Sales and Presales to validate demand and consolidate feedback from
    
  active opportunities, tenders, demos and deployments.

**Emerging markets and new product identification:**

* Track emerging technologies, applications and procurement trends across Smart
    
  & Safe Cities, intelligent traffic management, video analytics and enterprise
    
  security.
* Identify new hardware, software and integrated product opportunities, including
    
  adjacent markets where Vehant can build on its existing technology, customer
    
  relationships or channel partnerships.
* Validate shortlisted opportunities with customers, consultants and MSIs.
    
  Establish the target buyer, problem to solve, willingness to pay and likely route to
    
  market.
* Build business cases covering demand, revenue potential, differentiation,
    
  technical feasibility, development and sourcing costs, certification requirements
    
  and time to market.
* Recommend whether to build, source or partner. Define measurable pilot success
    
  criteria for approved concepts.

**Competition analysis and product differentiation:**

* Benchmark competing products on functionality, field performance, integration,
    
  certifications, pricing and total cost of ownership.
* Use competitive gaps and customer feedback to define new unique selling
    
  propositions (USPs) with measurable customer benefits.
* Validate proposed USPs through comparative testing, demonstrations or field
    
  pilots and equip Sales and Presales with the evidence to communicate them.

**Product roadmap and specification finalisation:**

* Own and prioritise the hardware and software roadmap based on customer
    
  demand, commercial potential, technical feasibility and resource availability.
* Finalise product specifications with Development, Technical, IT and Quality
    
  teams. Cover performance, interfaces, interoperability, cybersecurity,
    
  environmental conditions and deployment constraints as applicable
* Define measurable acceptance criteria and secure cross-functional sign-off before
    
  development or sourcing commitments. Assess the cost, schedule and compliance
    
  impact of subsequent specification changes.

**Cross-functional execution, launch and lifecycle management:**

* Work with Sales and Presales on positioning and opportunity feedback,
    
  Development on feasibility and release delivery, Technical and Service teams on
    
  field validation and supportability, and IT on infrastructure, cybersecurity and
    
  deployment readiness.
* Coordinate prototypes, proofs of concept, field trials and release readiness
    
  reviews. Resolve dependencies and escalate decisions that affect scope, cost or
    
  timelines.
* Drive launch readiness through datasheets, compliance matrices, demonstrations,
    
  release notes and training for Sales, Presales and Service.
* Track adoption, field performance and recurring service issues. Use the findings
    
  to prioritise enhancements, upgrades and end-of-life decisions.

title: Senior Product Manager I
job_description:
**Senior Product Manager - Search & Analytics Platform**

  

Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the data, query, and context foundations that help customers and AI agents understand and act on operational and security telemetry.

Effective investigation depends on finding the right data, querying it efficiently, and understanding how it relates to the customer's environment. As AI agents take on more analytical work, they need dependable access to telemetry and context: which service an entity belongs to, what it depends on, who owns it, and what changed. This role owns the shared platform capabilities that make that possible across observability, security, and platform optimization.

You will own established search and analytics capabilities while building toward federated analytics and a richer customer context foundation. This is a technically deep role requiring first-hand experience with data platforms, search, or analytics products, and the judgment to turn a broad platform vision into useful capabilities that teams can adopt.

**What You Will Own**

**The search and query platform.** Search and query capabilities, query language and analytical functions, partitions, views, and shared query services. You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing analytical depth, ease of use, and cost for both human and agent workloads.

**Federated analytics.** Define how customers and agents query and correlate Sumo data with data in connected systems. Establish the use cases, supported analytical capabilities, and tradeoffs around data movement, freshness, performance, permissions, and cost, working closely with the teams responsible for integrations and access.

**Customer context and the knowledge graph.** Build the shared understanding of a customer's environment: entities, services, workloads, ownership, topology, and dependencies. Define how that context is assembled from telemetry, metadata, and connected systems, how relationships are maintained, and how the accumulated context improves investigation and analysis over time.

**Data discovery and shared context services.** Help people and agents discover available sources, schemas, fields, and relationships, and retrieve the data and context relevant to a task. Own the shared capabilities that make this information reusable across product experiences, with clear provenance, freshness, and permission boundaries.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for the data and analytics platform, connecting current customer needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation.
* Own the health and evolution of shipping query capabilities, partitions, and views, using customer feedback and workload data to prioritize improvements.
* Work with engineering and architecture on query execution, distributed analytics, scalability, and cost at enterprise scale.
* Define and validate federated analytics use cases, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.
* Develop the entity and context strategy, including how services and resources are identified consistently across data sources and related to one another.
* Partner with investigation, security, knowledge, and agent teams to turn their needs into shared platform capabilities and clear interfaces.
* Partner with the product and engineering teams responsible for platform governance to ensure query and context capabilities respect established access controls, audit requirements, and cost policies.
* Translate strategy into clear proposals, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.
* Measure query success, latency, reliability, cost, context quality, and adoption, and show how platform improvements improve customer outcomes.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of data platforms, search, query systems, or analytics products. Relevant platform experience is a hard requirement.
* Strong technical understanding of query processing, data organization, indexing, schemas, and distributed systems, with depth in one or more of these areas.
* Experience running a live product at scale, balancing customer commitments, performance, reliability, and cost while delivering a longer-term roadmap.
* Experience building shared platform capabilities, APIs, or services used by multiple product teams or external developers.
* The ability to reason about analytical correctness, incomplete data, data freshness, and the limits of what a system can reliably infer.
* Familiarity with federated analytics, metadata platforms, entity resolution, knowledge graphs, or retrieval systems. Experience in one or more of these areas is valuable.
* An understanding of how AI agents discover data, use tools, and retrieve context, or the ability to ramp quickly. Observability or security analytics experience is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using SQL, dashboards, and usage data to understand customer behavior and evaluate tradeoffs.
* Clear communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write proposals that explain options, dependencies, and recommendations.

**Must Have Qualities**

* **Platform judgment.** Finds common needs across teams and turns them into capabilities others can depend on.
* **Customer grounding.** Connects technical investment to a concrete improvement in analysis, investigation, or cost.
* **Data correctness and trust.** Treats accuracy, consistency, provenance, and freshness as product requirements.
* **Runs today and builds tomorrow.** Keeps current capabilities healthy while delivering the next generation of the platform.
* **High ownership.** Resolves ambiguity, makes tradeoffs explicit, and drives work through delivery and adoption.

**About Us**
------------

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

job_description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

* Responsible for the achievement of Trade & FX targets assigned to the branches/channels
* Takes care of about 6 – 12 branches and mostly aligned with ABM of branch banking, OR, a particular business segment (like Privy, Wealth, WCG, CorpSal etc)
* Identifies the TFX opportunities in the assigned catchment / segment
* Regularly interacts with the branches / channels and presents the analysis of stock, market intelligence
* Identifies the training needs and puts the capability building plan in place
* Gathers the gather market information / competition trends to facilitate product developments / improvements by H O Product team
* Monitors the services standards/TAT and fixes the gaps, if any, by taking up with H.O
* Responsible for the quality of the accounts and compliance issues
* Ensures all customer queries/complaints, if any, are responded within the defined TAT
* Ensures that the branches / channels are adhered to all processes & guidelines
* Responsible for the channel / team’s productivity

**Personality Traits & Required Skills:**

* Should have the business acumen to spot the opportunities and make a business case to penetrate the market by preparing catchment specific strategy
* Ability to engage with various channels across Consumer Bank and leave a positive impact in every interaction
* Must be an effective communicator. Need to have good articulation skills
* Should possess good analytical & presentation skills

**Qualification:**

* B.E/B.Tech & MBA – the most preferred
* CA – second preference
* MBA is a must for the candidates, other than CA OR B.E/B.Tech

**Experience Required & Age Criteria**

* 5 - 8 years of relevant experience, i.e., Trade & Forex
* Age Criteria : Upto 35 Years

job_description:
**Product Manager – Power Solutions (UPS)**

**Location:** Mumbai  
**Experience:**  5+ Years  
**Qualification:** Graduate (Engineering preferred)

We are looking for an experienced **Product Manager – Power Solutions (UPS)** with hands-on expertise in designing, configuring, deploying, and supporting UPS solutions for medium and large enterprises. This is a techno-commercial role requiring strong technical knowledge, customer engagement, and business development skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable UPS and critical power solutions.

· Work closely with OEMs and vendors to design, configure, and deliver optimal solutions.

· Prepare technical proposals, BOMs/BOQs, solution designs, and commercial quotations.

· Support the sales team in customer meetings, product presentations, and lead generation activities.

· Conduct product demonstrations, technical workshops, and customer discussions.

· Train and mentor technical teams on UPS deployment, commissioning, and support.

· Educate and enable sales teams on UPS solutions, market trends, and competitive positioning.

· Drive product growth through market analysis, opportunity identification, and customer engagement.

**Required Skills**

· Strong hands-on experience with UPS systems, power backup solutions, and critical power infrastructure.

· Knowledge of enterprise and data center power solutions.

· Experience working with leading UPS OEMs and technology partners.

· Ability to understand customer requirements and develop techno-commercial solutions.

· Strong proposal preparation, costing, and solution-selling skills.

· Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management abilities.

· Ability to conduct technical and sales training programs.

**Interested candidates may share their updated resume to hr@turbonet.co.in with the subject line "Product Manager – Power Solutions (UPS)".**

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**Job Title**

**Treasury Products & Process Transformation**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as a **product champion** for Treasury offerings (FX, derivatives, remittances, investment and liability products as applicable), with deep understanding of end‑to‑end processes.
* Own and document **Treasury product workflows** , identifying gaps, redundancies, and operational risks across front‑to‑back processes.
* Support **new product launches, enhancements, and regulatory‑driven changes** , ensuring seamless implementation across systems and teams.
* Drive **process re‑engineering initiatives** to improve efficiency, reduce TAT, minimise manual interventions, and enhance control effectiveness.
* Lead the **ideation, design, and rollout of AI‑driven use cases** across Treasury, including (but not limited to):
  + Client engagement and decision‑support tools
  + Process automation and exception management
  + Data analytics, insights, and dashboarding
* Work closely with internal AI/Tech teams/vendors to ensure **practical, scalable, and compliant AI adoption** .
* Partner with **Compliance, Risk, Legal, Finance, and Operations** to ensure that all processes and products are **regulatory‑compliant and audit‑ready** .
* Facilitate cross‑functional working groups for Treasury transformation initiatives.
* Collaborate with Treasury Sales teams to **improve customer journeys** , reduce friction points, and enhance overall client experience.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of **Treasury products and workflows** (FX, derivatives, remittances, investments, liabilities – depending on scope).
* Hands‑on experience in **process improvement, automation, or digital transformation** within a bank or financial institution.
* Working understanding of **AI / analytics / automation concepts** and their application in financial services.
* Ability to define **business requirements** , user stories, and process maps.

**Education & Experience**

* MBA / CA / Engineering or equivalent professional qualification.
* **4-7 years** of experience in **Treasury, Product, Operations, Process Excellence, or Digital Transformation roles** within banking or financial services.
* Exposure to **cross‑functional projects and large‑scale change initiatives** will be a strong advantage.

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**About the Role and Team:**

A hybrid Product Manager role embedded within the Data Science team. You'll own the product direction for ML-driven capabilities — bidding algorithms, traffic quality (fraud detection), and audience modeling — while maintaining the operational rigor required for MRC/TAG compliance. You'll be part of the broader PM community, following established practices and gradually expanding your scope.

**We hope you are ready to change the game! Be ready to:**

**Product Management**

* Own and prioritize the Data Science team backlog; define user stories and acceptance criteria
* Lead scopes where domain knowledge is primarily algorithm/ML-driven; support cross team scopes as a secondary PM
* Participate in roadmap planning, sprint planning, and PM syncs, and uphold established PM ways of working — from templates and documentation standards to consistent communication and proactive
* stakeholder management
* Bridge Product leadership and Data Scientists — translate business needs into technical priorities and vice versa  
    
  **Algorithm Analysis & Validation**
* Analyze and validate ML algorithm outputs (bidding, delivery predictions, audience models) against business KPIs
* Test model outputs, identify when and why algorithms underperform, and provide actionable feedback to data scientists
* Conduct advanced investigation and analysis for algorithm-related performance issues
* Support A/B test design and analysis for algorithm changes  
    
  **Ad & Traffic Quality (Fraud) Operations**
* Investigate fraud-related issues — IP/domain/app unblocking, ads.txt issues, discrepancy reports, DOOH/CTV/Retail Media whitelisting
* Manage fraud blacklists (IP, domain, UA, app) using internal tools
* Run compliance cycles — Backward Looking Assessments, quarterly risk assessments, IVT filter reviews,
* TAG/IWL list updates, methodology disclosures — and look for opportunities to AI automate the recurring,
* Repeatable parts rather than only running them manually
* Support TAG/MRC audits and contribute to RFI/RFP responses on traffic quality  
    
  **Industry & AI Awareness**
* Track AdTech trends, AI/ML developments, and competitive landscape to inform priorities

**Attitude First. Everything else will follow. We can grow together faster if you have:**

* 3–5 years in a product, analytics, or technical role working alongside data science/ML teams
* 1–2 years of experience in AdTech or programmatic advertising
* Hands-on experience testing or analyzing ML model outputs (not building them)
* Strong analytical skills — SQL, data analysis tools, basic statistics
* Solid product fundamentals — backlog management, stakeholder alignment, acceptance criteria
* Excellent communication — can explain algorithm behavior to non-technical stakeholders

**Stand out by having:**

* Comfort working in an AI-native way — using LLMs and AI tooling to accelerate analysis, drafting, and
* Investigation, and a sense for where recurring workflows can be automated rather than just executed
* Familiarity with ad fraud / IVT concepts and MRC/TAG standards
* Experience with A/B testing and experimentation frameworks
* Python/R for data exploration

**Our promise to you:**

* A dynamic, inspiring, and international environment filled with ambitious and caring colleagues

* Premium health insurance with ₹10,00,000 coverage for you and your family

* 24 paid vacation days to enjoy life outside of work

* Paid maternity (6 months) and paternity (2 weeks)

* Annual learning budget to help you grow your skills and support continuous learning

* Rewarding referral program for helping us grow

* Global perks such as birthday gifts, work anniversaries, and company events to connect with colleagues and have fun

* And much more – join us to explore the full experience

**Diversity & Inclusion @Adform:**

Adform is an equal opportunity employer with a global perspective. We remain committed to creating an environment that not only respects different backgrounds but celebrates them too. We believe that diversity in all its forms enhances our teams’ creativity, innovation, and effectiveness, and therefore we value different backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

We are committed to creating a work environment where Adform employees feel valued for who they are and what they can contribute, free from any type of discrimination.

title: Product Manager-Components
job_description:
Job Description

Position: Product Manager-Components

Reporting: Global Technical Lead

Job Location: Mumbai

Grade Level: Management

Purpose:

Product Manager Components will be responsible for managing and developing lubricant additive components. The

role involves technical evaluation, product development, performance testing, troubleshooting and providing technical

support to customers, suppliers and internal business teams.

The position requires strong technical knowledge of lubricant additives chemistries, base oils, finished lubricants,

testing methodologies and industry standards, along with the ability to coordinate technical projects and ensure

successful product qualification.

Responsibilities:

Technical Product Development & Management

 Manage and develop lubricant additive components and formulations for various applications.

 Evaluate raw materials, base oils, additive packages and their compatibility.

 Identify opportunities for new product development and improvement of existing formulations.

 Conduct technical assessments of product performance and suitability for different applications.

 Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturers for technical specifications and product improvements.

 Coordinate with external laboratories for product testing and evaluation.

 Review and interpret laboratory test reports and technical data.

 Ensure testing is conducted as per applicable ASTM, ISO and other international standards.

 Evaluate test results and recommend necessary formulation improvements.

 Monitor product quality, consistency and performance against specifications.

Customer Technical Support

 Provide technical assistance and solutions to customers as per lubricant application.

 Handle technical queries, product complaints and troubleshooting requirements.

 Conduct technical discussions and presentations with customers.

 Support customer product trials, field evaluations and product qualification.

 Coordinate with the sales team to understand customer requirements and provide appropriate technical

solutions.

Supplier & Vendor Coordination

 Coordinate with global additive manufacturers, component suppliers and technical partners.

 Obtain and evaluate technical data sheets (TDS), safety data sheets (SDS), certificates of analysis (COA) and

product specifications.

 Review new products and assess their technical suitability.

 Maintain technical communication with international suppliers and partners.

Technical Documentation & Compliance

 Prepare and maintain technical reports, product specifications and evaluation reports.

 Maintain product development records and technical documentation.

 Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and customer requirements.

 Support product qualification, technical audits and customer assessments.

 Maintain updated technical databases for products, components and formulations.

Team & Project Coordination

 Coordinate with internal technical, sales, operations and laboratory teams.

 Monitor technical projects and ensure completion within agreed timelines.

 Provide technical guidance and support to team members.

 Participate in customer meetings, technical conferences, exhibitions and industry events.

 Submit regular technical progress reports to management.

Qualifications & Experience required:

Qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Petroleum Technology, Lubricant

Technology or a related discipline. Additional qualifications or certifications in lubricant technology and additive

chemistry will be an advantage.

Level of experience: 8–12 years of relevant experience in the lubricant additives, lubricants, petroleum or specialty

chemicals industry.

Technical skills: Strong understanding of lubricant additive chemistry, base oils and finished lubricant formulations.

Product development, technical evaluation and performance testing. Understanding of engine oils, industrial lubricants,

greases and specialty lubricants. Knowledge of ASTM, API, ACEA and relevant international specifications. Knowledge of

tribology testing, good analytical skills. Technical writing, Proven customer focus.

Behavioural competencies: Excellent communication and technical presentation skills, good interpersonal skills, team

spirit, open mindedness, sense of creativity.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

 Successful completion of technical development and product qualification projects.

 Timely resolution of customer technical queries and complaints.

 Accuracy and quality of technical evaluations and reports.

 Successful coordination of laboratory testing and product validation.

 Development and improvement of lubricant additive components and formulations.

 Technical support provided to sales and business development teams.

 Effective supplier and customer technical coordination.

 Achievement of project milestones within agreed timelines.

Stakeholders

Internal: Global Technical Head / Director – Technical & Technology, Technical Team, Sales & Business Development

Team, Operations & Administration Team

External: Suppliers, customers, OEM, third party labs, Universities, consultants and industry partners

General Expectations

 Maintain confidentiality of company information, formulations and technical data.

 Demonstrate professional conduct in all internal and external communications.

 Take ownership of assigned technical responsibilities and projects.

 Maintain a customer-focused and solution-oriented approach.

 Be willing to travel domestically and internationally as per business requirements.

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Freight Product Manager
job_description:
Posting Start Date: 11/16/26

**Purpose of the Job**
----------------------

The Freight Product Manager - Ocean Freight is responsible for the overall management, growth, and operational performance of the Ocean Freight business. The role leads the Ocean Freight product portfolio across FCL, LCL, and value-added ocean logistics solutions, while ensuring operational excellence, service quality, customer satisfaction, and commercial success.

The role is accountable for Ocean Freight operational performance, carrier and vendor management, trade lane development, pricing strategy, operational delivery, and team leadership. Working closely with Sales, Procurement, Finance, Customer Service, and Regional and Global Product teams, the role ensures that the Ocean Freight business achieves its revenue, profitability, productivity, service quality, and customer experience objectives.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Develop and execute the Ocean Freight product strategy in alignment with country, regional, and global freight objectives.
  
Manage and develop FCL, LCL, consolidation, multimodal, and other value-added Ocean Freight solutions based on customer requirements and market opportunities.
  
Monitor market trends, competitor activity, freight rates, capacity, and industry developments to strengthen the Ocean Freight proposition.
  
Partner with Sales on strategic opportunities, RFQs, tenders, key accounts, and customer solution development, providing product, pricing, routing, carrier, and transit-time guidance.
  
Own Ocean Freight pricing governance within approved commercial frameworks and support initiatives to improve margins, conversion, customer retention, and trade lane performance.
  
Develop priority import and export trade lanes and monitor volumes, yield, gross profit, service performance, and growth opportunities.
  
Lead overall Ocean Freight operational performance across import, export, FCL, and LCL activities, ensuring timely, compliant, accurate, and cost-effective shipment execution.
  
Establish and monitor operational KPIs covering service performance, shipment visibility, productivity, billing accuracy, aging shipments, customer complaints, and service failures.
  
Ensure adequate operational capacity, resources, processes, and controls to support business growth and customer commitments.
  
Lead the resolution of significant operational, carrier, vendor, pricing, and customer escalations, ensuring appropriate root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
  
Develop strong relationships with shipping lines, NVOCCs, consolidators, transport providers, CFS operators, and other logistics partners.
  
Partner with Procurement to secure competitive freight rates, capacity, equipment availability, service levels, and appropriate commercial terms.
  
Manage carrier capacity and space requirements across key trade lanes and monitor supplier performance covering reliability, rates, capacity, claims, and responsiveness.
  
Engage with strategic customers and key accounts to understand their requirements and develop customized Ocean Freight and multimodal solutions.

job_description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**

**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.**

Together with analytics team leaders you will support our business with excellent data models to uncover trends that can drive long-term business results.

**How you will contribute**

You will:

* Work in close partnership with the business leadership team to execute the analytics agenda
* Identify and incubate best-in-class external partners to drive delivery on strategic projects
* Develop custom models/algorithms to uncover signals/patterns and trends to drive long-term business performance
* Execute the business analytics program agenda using a methodical approach that conveys to stakeholders what business analytics will deliver

**What you will bring**

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

* Using data analysis to make recommendations to senior leaders
* Technical experience in roles in best-in-class analytics practices
* Experience deploying new analytical approaches in a complex and highly matrixed organization
* Savvy in usage of the analytics techniques to create business impacts

**IN THIS ROLE** — Lead end-to-end lifecycle ownership of one or more Data Products on Mondelēz's DBx-based enterprise data platform. Accountable for requirements, roadmap, design governance, delivery quality, operational oversight, and retirement execution. Combines strategic product ownership with hands-on analytical execution.

**WHAT THIS TEAM AND ROLE DOES** — Part of the MDS Data Products team driving AI-native transformation. Global data product strategy, delivery, and governance across the full lifecycle (demand intake discovery design build test deploy operate retire). Works at the intersection of business strategy, data governance, and technical delivery.

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING** — Experience bridging business and technical teams in data product delivery; passion for data governance and quality; strong stakeholder management across various stakeholders.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**:

* Own and maintain the data product roadmap.
* Facilitate data contracts with stakeholders.
* Engage with cross functional teams on demand prioritization and enterprise-level decisions.
* Lead requirements gathering, functional analysis, fit-gap assessments and scoping.
* Oversee design fitment, source discovery, and Source-to-Target Mapping (STTM).
* Approve initial designs, HLD, DIF documentation.
* Execute STTM mapping and document gap findings.
* Approve DQ validation, KPI acceptance, and release documentation.
* Prepare test cases, execute test scripts, and produce test evidence documentation.
* Coordinate UAT logistics - liaise with business stakeholders and document outcomes.
* Own UAT sign-off and Data Product assessments.
* Drive and own the Data Product Certification process.
* Prepare certification artefacts and supporting documentation.
* Own data product release and CAB documentation.

**SPECIFIC SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or related field.
* 5+ years in data product management, data analytics, or data engineering roles.
* Strong understanding of data lifecycle management (ingestion through retirement).
* Experience with cloud data platforms (GCP/BigQuery preferred).
* Hands-on experience with STTM mapping, DQ validation, and data quality frameworks.
* Familiarity with data governance frameworks, metadata management, and data contracts.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

**GOOD TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES:**

* Experience with DBT, Airflow/Composer, or similar data pipeline tools.
* Knowledge of FAIR data principles and data certification frameworks
* Background in FMCG/CPG industry data environments.
* Familiarity with data catalog tools (Collibra, Alation, Dataplex).
* Understanding of canonical data modeling and enterprise data standards.
* Experience with Jira and ADO.

No Relocation support available

**Business Unit Summary**
-------------------------

### **At Mondelēz International, our purpose is to empower people to snack right by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way. That means delivering a broad range of delicious, high-quality snacks that nourish life's moments, made with sustainable ingredients and packaging that consumers can feel good about.**

### **We have a rich portfolio of strong brands globally and locally including many household names such as** ***Oreo*****,** ***belVita*** **and** ***LU*** **biscuits;** ***Cadbury Dairy Milk*****,** ***Milka*** **and** ***Toblerone*** **chocolate;** ***Sour Patch Kids*** **candy and** ***Trident*** **gum. We are proud to hold the top position globally in biscuits, chocolate and candy and the second top position in gum.**

### **Our 80,000 makers and bakers are located in more** **than 80 countries** **and we sell our products in** **over 150 countries** **around the world. Our people are energized for growth and critical to us living our purpose and values. We are a diverse community that can make things happen—and happen fast.**

Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

**Job Type**
------------

RegularAnalytics & ModellingAnalytics & Data Science

title: Senior Product Manager- Lakehouse
job_description:
**Business Area:**

Product Mgmt.

**Seniority Level:**

Mid-Senior level

**Job Description:**

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

Cloudera is looking for a Senior product manager for the Lakehouse group within the Data Services Pillar. This is a highly visible role that will have a lasting impact on the strategic direction of the company and customer success.

As Senior product manager you will be responsible for all product lifecycle activities from vision to implementation, including customer development, product strategy and roadmap, coordination with engineering, marketing, business development, and substantial pre- and post-sales field engagement. You will serve as an internal and external expert on data collection, movement and processing from the edge across cloud environments to the customer data centers, and work directly with customers and field teams to grow the business.

You are empathetic, data-driven, and relentlessly focused on making your users more productive. Your experience with data collection, data movement and analytics on data in flight enables you to set a compelling vision for your product and ensure its success in the market.

At Cloudera you will work everyday with world-class customers, partners, technical field experts, and software engineers to define and advocate for the future of data collection and movement. We value thoughtfulness, a love of learning new things, creativity, diverse perspectives, and a sense of humor.

**As a Senior Product Manager you will..**
------------------------------------------

* Product design - Functional analysis that identifies the best options for compelling, easy to use software
* Engineering engagement - Close partnership with engineering to understand technical trade-offs and architecture in order to successfully influence product design
* Focus - Constant prioritization across several competing objectives for optimal use of time and resources
* Customer development - In-person and virtual interviews to understand users, priorities and design considerations
* Product and market strategy - Researching market segments, assessing competitive differentiation, creating decision frameworks, formulating hypotheses and advocating direction
* Launch and evangelism - Communicate product vision to press, analysts, and the wider big data ecosystem to create a strong tailwind for Sales; work with product marketing to create product demos and other technical sales tools; develop conference presentations and other collateral to highlight capabilities
* Sales support - Enable our field and partners, and directly support key opportunities
* Organizational leadership - Work with customers, support, and engineering teams to handle and resolve any critical customer issues that arise with our product
* Whatever else is needed to help sell Cloudera products, delight our customers, support our field teams, and help the company grow

**We are excited if you have….**
--------------------------------

* You should be quite familiar with leading practices in data warehousing, data lakehouses, and data lakes..
* Experience building products using technologies such as Apache Iceberg and Apache Polaris is a strong plus.
* Strong understanding of open table formats, metadata management, and data interoperability across analytics platforms.
* Understanding of cloud-native data platforms and services across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* You have been a product manager, or another business oriented / customer facing technical role where you have delivered innovative products and nurtured their continued success
* You understand what makes great enterprise platform software
* You possess superlative written, verbal, and visual communication skills
* The position will be based out of India

**What you can expect from us:**

* Generous PTO Policy
* Support work life balance with Unplugged Days
* Flexible WFH Policy
* Mental & Physical Wellness programs
* Phone and Internet Reimbursement program
* Access to Continued Career Development
* Comprehensive Benefits and Competitive Packages
* Paid Volunteer Time
* Employee Resource Groups

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Powering the agentic revolution in travel.** Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

Team Description
  
  
We are seeking a **Senior Product Manager** to join our Digital Experience team. The team owns and scales whitelabel e-commerce and post-booking servicing products for leading global airline partners, connecting complex airline and retailing capabilities with modern digital experiences to deliver seamless traveler journeys.

  

As a Senior Product Manager, you will help drive the roadmap and execution of our **Digital Experience (DX)** product across SabreSonic and SabreMosaic platforms. You will work closely with engineering, architecture, delivery, commercial teams and global airline customers to translate business and customer needs into scalable product capabilities.

  

The role combines product strategy with hands-on execution. You will manage roadmap priorities and customer requirements, guide agile backlogs, partner with technical teams on solution direction, and help evolve our products as the airline industry transitions toward modern Offer & Order retailing.
  
  
**What you'll do**

* Own and evolve product roadmaps for Digital Experience capabilities across SabreSonic and SabreMosaic, balancing strategic roadmap priorities, customer commitments and platform modernization.
* Manage product requirements and priorities for DX and DXCI, including customer change requests, roadmap initiatives and ongoing product enhancements.
* Translate customer and business needs into clearly defined product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria for agile engineering teams.
* Partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to evaluate solution options, understand technical trade-offs and deliver scalable product capabilities.
* Work directly with global airline customers, delivery teams and commercial stakeholders to understand requirements, identify product gaps and shape product priorities.
* Support the evolution of digital experiences as airline customers transition from traditional PNR-based workflows toward Offer & Order retailing.
* Analyze product issues, customer escalations and maintenance requirements in partnership with engineering and delivery teams, helping determine appropriate product solutions.
* Use customer feedback, product data, industry trends and operational insights to inform prioritization and product decisions.
* Deliver product demonstrations, roadmap discussions and capability presentations to internal stakeholders and global airline customers.
Coordinate across multiple parallel initiatives and customer commitments while maintaining clear prioritization and product direction.  

Qualifications and Education Requirements:

* 5+ years of product management or closely related experience, preferably working with complex enterprise software, e-commerce platforms or high-scale digital products.
* Demonstrated experience owning product capabilities through the full lifecycle, from requirements and prioritization through development, release and ongoing evolution.
* Experience working directly with engineering teams in an Agile/Scrum software development environment, including backlog management, story refinement and acceptance criteria.
* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand how APIs, backend services, platform capabilities and frontend experiences work together.
* Experience engaging directly with customers or partners to understand needs, define requirements and translate them into scalable product capabilities.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess competing requirements and make informed prioritization decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex product and technical concepts to both technical and business audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple initiatives and customer priorities simultaneously in a global environment.

We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses.

Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager / Product Owner
job_description:
##### **Project description**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to lead complex digital capabilities across KYC/AML and Client Lifecycle Management (CLM). You will work at the intersection of business stakeholders, Vendor teams, Architects and Engineers, driving the product development journey from discovery to delivery through continuous improvement.
  
  
This is a hands-on Individual Contributor role for someone comfortable moving between stakeholder workshops, process design, wireframes, API specifications, user stories, and Agile engineering delivery.

##### **Responsibilities**

Own product capabilities end-to-end from discovery, strategy and roadmap through delivery, adoption and optimisation.

Translate complex KYC/AML and business problems into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes.

Build and prioritise the product backlog, balancing business value, regulatory needs, technology dependencies and technical debt.

Lead discovery workshops and create process flows, client/user journeys, wireframes and UI mock-ups.

Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Operations, Product lead and business stakeholders.

Define requirements for REST APIs, including request/response behavior, JSON structures, data mapping, validation, errors and integration scenarios.

Drive Agile delivery through refinement, sprint planning, reviews and release planning.

Define appropriate non-functional requirements, including performance, availability, security, auditability, volumes and exception handling.

Use data and basic SQL to investigate issues, validate requirements and support product decisions.

Identify opportunities for automation, AI and Copilot to improve product delivery and operational efficiency.

##### **Skills**

Must have

At least 10 years of relevant experience, including strong hands-on Product Management/Product Ownership experience in complex enterprise environments.

Strong understanding of KYC/AML, Client Lifecycle Management, client onboarding, and periodic/event-driven KYC.

Proven experience delivering products using Agile/Scrum ways of working.

Excellent requirements, business-analysis and problem-solving skills.

Strong experience creating wireframes, UI mock-ups, user journeys, and process flows.

Good technical understanding of REST APIs, JSON and Swagger/OpenAPI specifications.

Working knowledge of SQL to perform data analysis.

Basic understanding of Azure/cloud, microservices, API gateways and event-driven integration concepts.

Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to bridge business and technology.

Confident working independently, influencing without authority and constructively challenging assumptions.

Proactive, positive and ownership-driven attitude, comfortable operating in ambiguity.

Effective use of Microsoft Copilot for requirements elicitation, documentation and productivity improvement.

Nice to have

Intelligent Document Processing, document management platform.

Experience with KYC/AML, handling external data providers.

Knowledge of Kafka/webhooks, asynchronous processing, Postman, GitLab/Jira/Confluence, data lineage and observability.

Experience with legal-entity/reference data, company registries, data reconciliation and multi-jurisdiction regulatory requirements.

##### **Other**

Languages

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

Seniority

Senior

  

Pune, India

job_description:
**Job Title**

Senior Product Manager, 1

**Job Description**

**Mandatory Skills**  

* Regularly review reports specific to your domains in order to monitor health, revenue, and other important KPIs.
* At least 4-5 years of hands-on product management—day-to-day product ownership. Demonstrable experience leading and participating in product management initiatives.
* Have owned product lifecycle at key junctures: ideation, vision, requirements, roadmap, specifications, analysis, and iteration.
* You think at scale and have experience launching products in new areas with ambiguity.
* Product experience with web applications/SPAs; native app experience is a nice to have
* You have sound business judgment, proven ability to influence others, and strong analytical skills.
* You possess a passion for figuring out user problems, are able to work iteratively, and have a bias for action.
* You’re excellent at communicating and collaborating with a wide range of teams and stakeholders to build great products.
* You have experience with data driven product development and possess a knowledge of agile methodologies.
* You can tell stories through data.
