author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager I
job_description:
About Us:

Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.

Overview:

Learning is where that mission gets personal. Our vision is Connected Learning: training, practice, and coaching that are always-on and tailored to each rep, grounded in what's actually happening in their deals. Because learning shares context with a rep's accounts, meetings, approved content, and skills, we can deliver what they need next, in the moment they need it, and show whether it moved the number.

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll lead key parts of two of our strategic themes: Adaptive Training, which removes the manual work for enablement teams and gives every rep only what they still need, and Continuous Learning, which brings learning into the flow of work so it sticks. You'll partner closely with others PMs on the team.

At Seismic, PMs operate as the general managers of their areas. You won't be handed a backlog of feature requests. You'll decide where the most valuable, durable opportunities are, place the bets, and own the results: adoption, expansion, retention, and revenue. This is a role for a PM who wants to run a business, not maintain a feature list.

Who you are::

* **5+ years of product management experience** building user-facing products (B2B or B2C). You're fluent in discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch, and you don't need training on the fundamentals.
* **An AI-forward way of working**. You use AI every day to work faster and better, whether that's synthesizing research, prototyping, drafting specs, or analyzing data, and you can share specific recent examples.
* **A business owner's mindset**. You think in terms of outcomes, unit economics, and durable value, define clear success metrics, read the data, and change course when the evidence says so.
* **Technical fluency**. You can have credible conversations with engineers about LLMs, agent harness, data, and design tradeoffs.
* **A strong point of view**, held with humility. You can turn ambiguity into a clear plan and bring engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success along with you.
* Comfort working with distributed teams across time zones, including occasional early or late meetings.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

**Bonus points**

* You've shipped AI products, such as agents, copilots, or AI-powered features, and know what it takes to make them reliable.
* You've built learning products, in corporate learning, sales enablement and readiness, edtech, or consumer learning.
* You're curious about how people learn: spaced reinforcement, mastery learning, coaching, and practice.
* A category being rewritten. AI is changing how sellers learn and how enablement teams work, and you'll help define what comes next.
* Ownership that's real. You'll run a meaningful area of the business, with the accountability and the room to match.
* Real scale from day one. Your work will reach enablement teams and sellers at some of the world's best-known brands.
* A team that builds with AI, not just for it. We use agentic tools in our own work and expect you to as well.

What you'll be doing::

* Run your areas like a business. Set the strategy and roadmap, choose the bets that create the most durable value, help shape how they're packaged and priced, and own the adoption, retention, and revenue outcomes that follow.
* Create best-in-class agentic training authoring and training management, so enablement teams turn the content they already trust into training in minutes and agents handle the busywork of assigning, tracking, and following up, whether teams work in Seismic or in the AI tools they already use.
* Make training adapt to every rep, so reps skip what they've already mastered and spend their time on what they still need.
* Bring learning into the flow of work with just-in-time micro-learning, instant answers grounded in training, and peer examples from top performers' real calls.
* Connect learning to performance. Use deal, meeting, and skill signals to decide what each rep needs next, and define how we prove impact beyond course completions.
* Stay close to customers. Talk with enablement leaders, sellers, and managers every week, run discovery with design and research, and bring a sharp point of view back to the team.
* Ship with engineering in fast, measurable increments, including the evals and quality bar that make AI features trustworthy.

Job Posting Footer:

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
About Bazaarvoice

At Bazaarvoice, we create smart shopping experiences. Through our expansive global network, product-passionate community & enterprise technology, we connect thousands of brands and retailers with billions of consumers. Our solutions enable brands to connect with consumers and collect valuable user-generated content, at an unprecedented scale. This content achieves global reach by leveraging our extensive and ever-expanding retail, social & search syndication network. And we make it easy for brands & retailers to gain valuable business insights from real-time consumer feedback with intuitive tools and dashboards. The result is smarter shopping: loyal customers, increased sales, and improved products.

The problem we are trying to solve : Brands and retailers struggle to make real connections with consumers. It's a challenge to deliver trustworthy and inspiring content in the moments that matter most during the discovery and purchase cycle. The result? Time and money spent on content that doesn't attract new consumers, convert them, or earn their long-term loyalty.

Our brand promise : closing the gap between brands and consumers.

Founded in 2005, Bazaarvoice is headquartered in Austin, Texas with offices in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.

It’s official: Bazaarvoice is a Great Place to Work in the US , Australia, India, Lithuania, France, Germany and the UK!

### **Job Description**

Influenster is the product-passionate member community at the heart of Bazaarvoice’s Consumer Acquisition & Sampling (CAS) business. Members discover products, try samples, and share honest reviews that power brand campaigns. The CAS Fundamentals team owns the core member experience that keeps this community healthy: onboarding, identity, trust, discovery, and the everyday reasons members come back.

As the Senior Product Manager for CAS Fundamentals, you will keep members happy, engaged, and coming back to Influenster. You will own the strategy and roadmap for the foundational member experience across web and app, and you will balance member delight with the legal, compliance, and data-quality foundations that make our campaigns work for brands.

### **How you’ll make an impact**

* Define the strategy and a 1–2 year roadmap for the Influenster member experience, with clear ownership of the CAS Fundamentals KPIs:

  + Monthly Active Members on Influenster
* Own the core member journey end to end, including:

  + Onboarding and activation
  + Member identity
  + Feed and search
  + App integration
  + Localization
  + Legal and compliance requirements
* Drive engagement and organic content growth and run experiments to grow the volume and richness of organic content.
* Discover and validate problems through member research, funnel and cohort analysis, and experimentation. Turn them into prioritized, well-scoped bets.
* Balance competing investments: member growth and engagement, trust and compliance, and the content inventory that supports brand campaigns.
* Partner with Engineering, Design, Legal, Marketing, and other CAS teams to ensure aligned backlogs and that engineering has what it needs to size, build, and ship.
* Own the full product lifecycle from discovery and build through launch, measurement, and iteration. Communicate outcomes with data-driven narratives that connect member engagement to business results.
* Stay close to the market: community, creator, and loyalty-app trends, plus the competitive landscape for consumer review and product-sampling experiences.

### **Essential Criteria**

* Experience building and scaling mobile apps in a D2C setting (helpful)
* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in consumer-facing products where engagement and retention are core metrics (communities, marketplaces, loyalty, social, or content platforms).
* Strong ownership of engagement metrics (MAU, retention, activation) and the ability to design and analyze experiments to move them.
* Experience with foundational consumer product areas such as onboarding, identity and account systems, feed or search, and localization.
* Ability to work through legal, privacy, and compliance requirements (consent, data handling, verification) without losing sight of member experience.
* Comfort with data: you define success metrics, run analyses, and use product analytics tools to make decisions.
* Ability to prioritize across competing goals and communicate trade-offs clearly to stakeholders and senior leadership.
* Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity in a multi-sided environment serving members, brands, and retailers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with a track record of working closely with engineering and design.

#li-NB1

**Why join Bazaarvoice?**

**Customer is key**

We see our own success through our customers’ outcomes.

We approach every situation with a customer first mindset.

**Transparency & Integrity Builds Trust**

We believe in the power of authentic feedback because it’s in our DNA.

We do the right thing when faced with hard choices. Transparency and trust accelerate our collective performance.

**Passionate Pursuit of Performance**

Our energy is contagious, because we hire for passion, drive & curiosity.

We love what we do, and because we’re laser focused on our mission.

**Innovation over Imitation**

We seek to innovate as we are not content with the status quo.

We embrace agility and experimentation as an advantage.

**Stronger Together**

We bring our whole selves to the mission and find value in diverse perspectives.

We champion what’s best for Bazaarvoice before individuals or teams.

As a stronger company we build a stronger community.

  

**Discover Life at Bazaarvoice**

**Want to see our culture in action?** **Explore our channels to see the bigger picture and meet the teams behind the tech: Global perspective : Head over to our global** **Linkedin Life P****age****,** **Life at Bazaarvoice****to see what makes us tick worldwide.**

**Regional Teams: Visit our** **APAC Life Page****to see what life is like in our local offices.**

**Want an inside look at** **Bazaarvoice India****?** **> Follow our journey and check out our team reviews on** **AmbitionBox**

**Commitment to diversity and inclusion**

Bazaarvoice provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all team members and applicants according to their experience, talent, and qualifications for the job without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, age, disability, sex (including pregnancy, gender stereotyping, and marital status), sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, military/veteran status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law in every location in which the company has facilities. Bazaarvoice believes that diversity and an inclusive company culture are key drivers of creativity, innovation and performance. Furthermore, a diverse workforce and the maintenance of an atmosphere that welcomes versatile perspectives will enhance our ability to fulfill our vision of creating the world’s smartest network of consumers, brands, and retailers.

  

**Please note that a standard background verification (BGV) forms part of our selection process. This will be conducted with your consent and will strictly focus on information relevant to the role.**

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Product Manager - Mutual Funds
job_description:
Designation: NA

Location: India Maharashtra Thane - GCorp

Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Role Overview**
=================

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own and investment products with a strong focus on Mutual Funds. The role will drive product strategy, roadmap, customer journeys, integrations and business outcomes across mobile and web platforms. The ideal candidate will have hands-on product management experience in a digital investment platform, wealth-tech company, fintech, bank or broking environment, and a strong understanding of the mutual fund investment lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1. Mutual Fund Product Ownership**
------------------------------------

* Own the end-to-end mutual fund product lifecycle across discovery, investment, servicing and portfolio management.
* Drive digital journeys for onboarding, KYC, risk profiling, lumpsum investments, SIP registration, mandate setup, purchase, redemption, switch, cancellation, SIP pause/modify and transaction tracking.
* Build and enhance fund discovery, scheme details, comparison, filters, portfolio views, performance analytics, goal-based investing and investor education features.
* Work on integrations with AMCs, RTAs, BSE StAR MF / relevant transaction platforms, payment gateways, banks and other ecosystem partners, as applicable.
* Improve funnel conversion, transaction success, SIP activation, repeat investments, AUM growth and customer retention.
* Ensure a seamless experience across direct and regular mutual fund propositions, where applicable.

**2. Digital Product Strategy & Execution**
-------------------------------------------

* Define product vision, strategy, roadmap, prioritisation and success metrics in line with business objectives and customer needs.
* Translate business requirements into BRDs, product requirement documents, user stories, use cases, process flows and acceptance criteria.
* Drive product discovery through customer insights, data analysis, market research and competitor benchmarking.
* Partner with UX/UI, engineering, QA, operations, compliance and business teams to deliver scalable and intuitive digital experiences.
* Lead sprint planning, backlog prioritisation, UAT, release management and post-launch monitoring.

**3. Wealth & Investment Products**
-----------------------------------

* Work across adjacent investment products such as equities, ETFs, fixed deposits, bonds, NCDs, NPS, digital gold, PMS and AIFs, based on business priorities.
* Identify opportunities to create integrated investment journeys, cross-sell relevant products and improve customer lifetime value.
* Collaborate with AMCs, banks, brokers, fintech partners and vendors for product launches and platform integrations.

**4. Analytics & Business Growth**
----------------------------------

* Define and track KPIs including visitor-to-investor conversion, KYC completion, SIP registrations, mandate success, order success, AUM, active investors and repeat transaction rates.
* Analyse customer behaviour, funnel drop-offs, cohorts and product usage to identify growth and experience improvements.
* Use experimentation, A/B testing and data-led prioritisation to optimise product journeys.
* Prepare product performance dashboards and business reviews for senior stakeholders.

**5. Regulatory, Risk & Compliance**
------------------------------------

* Work with compliance, legal and operations teams to translate applicable SEBI, AMFI, AMCs, RTA and other regulatory requirements into product features and controls.
* Ensure appropriate disclosures, risk profiling, suitability, consent, audit trails and transaction controls are incorporated into customer journeys.
* Support regulatory change implementation, issue resolution and applicable reporting requirements.

**Required Experience & Skills**
================================

* 10–14 years of overall experience, with substantial hands-on product management experience in mutual funds or digital investment platforms.
* Strong understanding of the mutual fund lifecycle, including onboarding/KYC, fund discovery, purchase, SIP, mandates, redemption, switch, portfolio tracking and servicing.
* Experience owning digital products on mobile apps and/or web platforms, preferably in a high-volume consumer fintech or wealth-tech environment.
* Ability to define product strategy, write clear requirements, prioritise roadmaps and deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Experience working with engineering, design, QA, operations, compliance, business teams and external technology partners.
* Strong product analytics, funnel analysis, problem-solving, stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Working knowledge of APIs, payment flows, integrations, Agile delivery and UAT.

**Preferred Company Background**
================================

Candidates from digital investment, wealth-tech, fintech, discount broking and online mutual fund platforms will be strongly preferred. Relevant target organisations may include:

* Groww
* Zerodha (especially Coin / mutual fund product teams)
* ET Money
* INDmoney
* Kuvera
* Paytm Money
* Upstox
* Angel One
* FundsIndia
* Scripbox
* Other comparable digital wealth or mutual fund investment platforms.

Important: Prior experience in one of the above companies is a sourcing preference, not a substitute for relevant product ownership. Candidates must have directly worked on mutual fund product features, journeys or platform enhancements. Experience limited to sales, relationship management, distribution or back-office operations without digital product ownership would not be sufficient for this role.

**Educational Qualifications**
==============================

* MBA / PGDM / MFM or postgraduate qualification in Finance, Management, Technology or a related discipline preferred.
* NISM or other relevant capital markets / mutual fund certifications will be an advantage.

**Key Performance Indicators**
==============================

* Growth in mutual fund investors, AUM and SIP registrations.
* Improvement in onboarding, KYC, mandate and transaction conversion rates.
* Order success rate, journey completion and reduction in customer drop-offs.

=================

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

------------------------------------

* Improve funnel conversion, transaction success, SIP activation, repeat investments, AUM growth and customer retention.
* Ensure a seamless experience across direct and regular mutual fund propositions, where applicable.

**2. Digital Product Strategy & Execution**
-------------------------------------------

* Define product vision, strategy, roadmap, prioritisation and success metrics in line with business objectives and customer needs.
* Translate business requirements into BRDs, product requirement documents, user stories, use cases, process flows and acceptance criteria.
* Drive product discovery through customer insights, data analysis, market research and competitor benchmarking.
* Partner with UX/UI, engineering, QA, operations, compliance and business teams to deliver scalable and intuitive digital experiences.
* Lead sprint planning, backlog prioritisation, UAT, release management and post-launch monitoring.

-----------------------------------

* Work across adjacent investment products such as equities, ETFs, fixed deposits, bonds, NCDs, NPS, digital gold, PMS and AIFs, based on business priorities.
* Identify opportunities to create integrated investment journeys, cross-sell relevant products and improve customer lifetime value.
* Collaborate with AMCs, banks, brokers, fintech partners and vendors for product launches and platform integrations.

**4. Analytics & Business Growth**
----------------------------------

* Define and track KPIs including visitor-to-investor conversion, KYC completion, SIP registrations, mandate success, order success, AUM, active investors and repeat transaction rates.
* Analyse customer behaviour, funnel drop-offs, cohorts and product usage to identify growth and experience improvements.
* Use experimentation, A/B testing and data-led prioritisation to optimise product journeys.
* Prepare product performance dashboards and business reviews for senior stakeholders.

**5. Regulatory, Risk & Compliance**
------------------------------------

* Work with compliance, legal and operations teams to translate applicable SEBI, AMFI, AMCs, RTA and other regulatory requirements into product features and controls.

**Required Experience & Skills**
================================

* 10–14 years of overall experience, with substantial hands-on product management experience in mutual funds or digital investment platforms.
* Strong understanding of the mutual fund lifecycle, including onboarding/KYC, fund discovery, purchase, SIP, mandates, redemption, switch, portfolio tracking and servicing.
* Experience owning digital products on mobile apps and/or web platforms, preferably in a high-volume consumer fintech or wealth-tech environment.
* Ability to define product strategy, write clear requirements, prioritise roadmaps and deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Experience working with engineering, design, QA, operations, compliance, business teams and external technology partners.
* Strong product analytics, funnel analysis, problem-solving, stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Working knowledge of APIs, payment flows, integrations, Agile delivery and UAT.

**Preferred Company Background**
================================

Candidates from digital investment, wealth-tech, fintech, discount broking and online mutual fund platforms will be strongly preferred. Relevant target organisations may include:

* Groww
* Zerodha (especially Coin / mutual fund product teams)
* ET Money
* INDmoney
* Kuvera
* Paytm Money
* Upstox
* Angel One
* FundsIndia
* Scripbox
* Other comparable digital wealth or mutual fund investment platforms.

Candidates must have directly worked on mutual fund product features, journeys or platform enhancements. **Educational Qualifications**
==============================

* MBA / PGDM / MFM or postgraduate qualification in Finance, Management, Technology or a related discipline preferred.
* NISM or other relevant capital markets / mutual fund certifications will be an advantage.

==============================

* Growth in mutual fund investors, AUM and SIP registrations.
* Improvement in onboarding, KYC, mandate and transaction conversion rates.
* Order success rate, journey completion and reduction in customer drop-offs.
* Feature adoption, active usage, repeat investments and customer retention.
* On-time delivery of roadmap commitments and quality of product releases.
* Regulatory readiness and timely implementation of compliance requirements.

job_description:
**Role Summary**
----------------

We are seeking an experienced and commercially focused Product Manager to lead the growth and execution of our **Private Markets Data & Feeds proposition** . This role will be responsible for defining and executing the product strategy, commercial roadmap, and go-to-market initiatives for private markets datasets across asset classes including Private Equity, Venture Capital, Private Credit, Infrastructure, and Real Assets.

The successful candidate will act as the intersection between clients, sales, content, technology, and strategic partners to deliver data products that meet the evolving needs of institutional investors, quantitative researchers, asset managers, wealth managers, banks, and alternative investment firms.

This is a highly visible role with responsibility for driving revenue growth, client adoption, product innovation, and market positioning within a rapidly expanding private markets ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Product Strategy & Commercial Leadership**

* Define and execute the commercial strategy for the Private Markets Data & Feeds business.
* Develop product vision, roadmap, and business cases aligned with client demand and market trends.
* Identify new revenue opportunities through new content offerings, delivery channels, partnerships, and licensing models.
* Establish pricing, packaging, and commercialization strategies to maximize market penetration and profitability.
* Own product P&L, growth targets, and business performance metrics.

### **Client & Market Engagement**

* Engage directly with Investment Banking, buy-side, sell-side, wealth, and research clients to understand current and emerging use cases.
* Translate client requirements into scalable product capabilities and data solutions.
* Represent the business externally at client meetings, industry conferences, webinars, and strategic forums.
* Gather competitive intelligence and monitor developments across private markets, alternative investments, and data providers.

### **Product Development & Execution**

* Partner closely with data Strategy, engineering, data operations, and delivery teams to prioritize product enhancements.
* Define requirements for data models, coverage expansion, feed structures, APIs, cloud delivery, and integration capabilities.
* Drive agile product development processes and ensure successful product launches.
* Monitor client feedback and usage analytics to identify product improvement opportunities.

### **Commercial & Go-To-Market Execution**

* Enable Sales and Customer Success teams through value propositions, positioning, competitive messaging, and sales collateral.
* Support major commercial opportunities, RFPs, strategic negotiations, and client onboarding activities.
* Develop market segmentation strategies and targeted growth plans for key client segments.
* Establish KPIs and monitor adoption, retention, revenue growth, and client satisfaction.

### **Strategic Partnerships**

* Identify and develop strategic relationships with private market participants, data providers, technology platforms, and ecosystem partners.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy opportunities and support acquisition, partnership, and investment initiatives.
Drive integration and commercialization of third-party datasets where appropriate.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Data Science, or related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Commercial Product Strategy, Market Data, Financial Information Services, or Alternative Investments.
* Strong understanding of Private Markets, including:
  + - M&A
  + - Equity New Issues
  + - Debt New issues
  + - Loans
  + - Repurchases
  + - Joint Venture
  + - Shareholder Activism
  + - Poinson Pill
  + - Municipals
  + - Sustainable Finance
  + - Private Equity
  + - Private Credit
  + - Real Assets
  + - Fund performance & Benchmarking
* Experience managing enterprise data products, data feeds, APIs, or cloud-based data distribution platforms.
* Demonstrated success driving product growth and commercial outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across multiple teams and senior leadership levels.
* Excellent presentation, communication, and client-facing skills.

* Experience within financial data providers, exchanges, investment research firms, alternative data vendors, or private markets technology platforms.
* Deep knowledge of institutional investor workflows and investment research processes.
* Familiarity with cloud data delivery platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Understanding of quantitative investment workflows and data integration requirements.

**Career Stage:**

Manager  
  
  

**LSEG unlocks the power of markets to create opportunities across the global economy.**

Through our connected network of market infrastructure, data and analytics, we help customers access capital, manage risk and make confident decisions.

  
  

Our insights bring clarity to complex markets, and our trusted services ensure resilience and stability. With deep expertise and global scale, we partner with customers to drive innovation and shape the future of finance.

  

Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you’ll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what’s next for our business and the global economy.

  
  

Guided by our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change, we bring together diverse perspectives, encourage fresh thinking, and create an environment where learning never stops.

  

Join more than 26,000 colleagues across 60 countries, supporting customers in over 170 countries. Alongside flexible ways of working, you'll have access to benefits that support your wellbeing and your future, including 26 weeks' parental leave, healthcare, retirement planning and a wellness allowance. Through the LSEG Foundation and two paid volunteering days each year, you’ll also have opportunities to get involved in your local community and support causes that matter to you.

  
  

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

  
  

Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject .

  

By clicking on "Apply", the process for submitting an application will begin. If you have any questions prior to clicking "Apply", please contact the recruiter.

  
  

If you are submitting as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is essential and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to LSEG are aware of this privacy notice.

  
  

***LSEG. Make more possible.***

title: Senior Product Manager I
job_description:
**Senior Product Manager**

**Response Automation (SIEM and SOAR)**

Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the automation foundations that help security teams and AI agents turn detections into fast, safe, consistent response.

Finding a threat is half the job. Analysts still spend too much time enriching alerts, chasing context, opening tickets, and running containment steps by hand. As AI agents take on more of that work, response automation has to be dependable, auditable, and easy to control. This role owns the playbook, orchestration, and case management capabilities across Cloud SIEM and Cloud SOAR that make that possible.

You will own established automation capabilities while building toward agent-driven response and a tighter SIEM-to-SOAR experience. This is a technically deep role. It requires first-hand experience with security operations, SOAR, or workflow automation products, and the judgment to turn a broad platform vision into capabilities that SOC teams adopt and trust.

**What You Will Own**

**Playbooks and the automation engine.** The playbook editor, triggers, actions, execution engine, and the Automation Service. You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing power, ease of use, and cost for analysts, detection engineers, and agents.

**Cloud SIEM and Cloud SOAR together.** Define how insights and signals in Cloud SIEM trigger automations and hand off to Cloud SOAR for incident and case management. Establish where the Automation Service ends and full Cloud SOAR begins, with clear packaging, upgrade paths, and one coherent customer experience.

**Integrations, actions, and App Central.** Set the strategy for enrichment, notification, containment, user choice, and custom actions. Prioritize integrations across endpoint, identity, cloud, ticketing, threat intelligence, and messaging tools. Own coverage, quality, and lifecycle for out-of-the-box playbooks and integrations.

**Agentic and human-in-the-loop response.** Define how AI agents discover, invoke, and chain playbooks and actions. Establish the approval steps, scoped permissions, guardrails, and audit trails that let customers decide which responses run automatically and which need an analyst's sign-off.

  

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for response automation, connecting current SOC needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation and response.
* Own the health and evolution of shipping playbook, automation, and case management capabilities, using customer feedback and execution data to prioritize improvements.
* Work with engineering and architecture on execution reliability, scalability, error handling, and cost at enterprise scale.
* Define and validate response use cases, such as phishing, compromised identity, and endpoint containment, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.
* Develop the integration and action strategy, including how actions are named, scoped, versioned, and made safe to run without a person watching.
* Partner with detection, investigation, knowledge, and agent teams to turn their needs into shared automation capabilities and clear interfaces.
* Partner with the product and engineering teams responsible for platform governance to ensure automation respects established access controls, audit requirements, and cost policies.
* Translate strategy into clear proposals, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.
* Measure playbook success rate, time to respond, analyst time saved, reliability, cost, and adoption, and show how automation improvements lead to better security outcomes.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of security operations, SOAR, SIEM, or workflow automation products. Relevant platform experience is a hard requirement.
* Strong technical understanding of incident response workflows, orchestration engines, event-driven systems, APIs, and the integrations that connect security tools.
* Experience running a live product at scale, balancing customer commitments, reliability, and cost while delivering a longer-term roadmap.
* Experience building shared platform capabilities, APIs, or services used by multiple product teams, partners, or external developers.
* The ability to reason about automation risk, including false positives, partial failures, and the point where a human should approve an action.
* Familiarity with SOC operations and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and the NIST incident response lifecycle. Experience with case management, threat intelligence, or integration marketplaces is valuable.
* An understanding of how AI agents discover tools, take actions, and operate within guardrails, or the ability to ramp quickly. Hands-on SOC or security engineering experience is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using SQL, dashboards, and usage data to understand customer behavior and evaluate tradeoffs.
* Clear communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write proposals that explain options, dependencies, and recommendations.

**Must Have Qualities**

* **Platform judgment.** Finds common needs across teams and turns them into capabilities others can depend on.
* **Customer grounding.** Connects technical investment to a concrete improvement in response time, analyst workload, or risk reduction.
* **Safety and trust.** Treats control, auditability, and predictable behavior as product requirements, especially when automation takes action on its own.
* **Runs today and builds tomorrow.** Keeps current capabilities healthy while delivering the next generation of the platform.
* **High ownership.** Resolves ambiguity, makes tradeoffs explicit, and drives work through delivery and adoption.

**About Us**
------------

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

* Clear communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write proposals that explain options, dependencies, and recommendations.

**Must Have Qualities**

* **Platform judgment.** Finds common needs across teams and turns them into capabilities others can depend on.
* **Customer grounding.** Connects technical investment to a concrete improvement in response time, analyst workload, or risk reduction.
* **Safety and trust.** Treats control, auditability, and predictable behavior as product requirements, especially when automation takes action on its own.
* **Runs today and builds tomorrow.** Keeps current capabilities healthy while delivering the next generation of the platform.
* **High ownership.** Resolves ambiguity, makes tradeoffs explicit, and drives work through delivery and adoption.

**About Us**
------------

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager
job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Turn concepts into delivery-ready work
  + Partner with product, clinical, operational, and engineering stakeholders to understand business problems, functional needs, users, workflows, and intended outcomes
  + Translate concepts into clear features, user stories, workflows, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies, and success measures
  + Seek clarity when needs are incomplete or conflicting rather than allowing assumptions to become requirements
  + Produce high-quality, usable features in partnership with engineering teams and refine them until they are ready for execution
* Create execution visibility and control
  + Maintain a clear view of each major deliverable, its owner, current status, progress, dependencies, barriers, and required decisions
  + Plan and facilitate meetings with a clear purpose and agenda; document decisions, owners, and next actions
  + Proactively communicate status, scope changes, risks, dependencies, and delivery impacts
  + Escalate risks early enough for stakeholders to resolve barriers or make informed tradeoffs before commitments shift
* Lead cross-functional collaboration
  + Build rapport and trusted working relationships with clinical experts, operations stakeholders, product partners, and engineering teams
  + Listen carefully, ask thoughtful follow-up questions, and ensure expert knowledge is understood, documented, retained, and applied to future work
  + Influence without direct authority and help stakeholders reach clarity on priorities, requirements, tradeoffs, and ownership
  + Coordinate initiatives that cross sprint boundaries or require alignment across multiple teams
* Advance healthcare workflow modernization
  + Develop an increasingly solid understanding of healthcare workflows, systems, data considerations, and operational constraints
  + Explore not only what needs to be built, but why it matters and how the workflow could be improved
  + Identify opportunities to apply technology, automation, interoperability, and AI to improve healthcare processes and outcomes
  + Keep healthcare privacy, data protection, regulatory, and governance considerations visible throughout product discovery and delivery
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field
* 5+ years of experience in product management, product ownership, business analysis, technology consulting, solution design, software delivery, or related disciplines supporting software-enabled products
* 3+ years of experience gathering, documenting, and managing business requirements, user stories, workflows, process maps, acceptance criteria, and delivery-ready product artifacts
* 3+ years of experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving business, operational, and technical stakeholders
* 3+ years of experience working within Agile software development environments such as Scrum, SAFe, Kanban, or similar frameworks
* Demonstrated experience translating complex or ambiguous business needs into clear, actionable requirements and product deliverables
* Demonstrated experience facilitating stakeholder discussions, driving alignment, documenting decisions, and managing competing priorities
* Proven experience identifying, communicating, and escalating risks, dependencies, scope changes, and delivery challenges
* Working knowledge of software development processes and technology concepts sufficient to collaborate effectively with engineering teams and ask informed technical questions
* Proven exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and meeting facilitation skills
* Demonstrated ability to organize multiple concurrent initiatives, deliverables, dependencies, and stakeholder groups
* Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority and build trusted relationships across product, operations, and technology teams
* Demonstrated learning agility and ability to quickly understand and retain knowledge about complex business domains

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Owner
job_description:
Requisition Number: 64952

Job Location: Bangalore, IND

Global Grade: Band 5

Work Type: Office Working

Employment Type: Permanent

Posting Start Date: 18/11/2026

Posting End Date: 12/12/2026

:

**Job Summary**
---------------

* Own the Cash product agenda across the Digital channels, with strategic accountability for translating Cash and Payments priorities into scalable capabilities across Host-to-Host (H2H), SWIFT and Common Channel Services (CCS).

• Lead the development, prioritisation and commercialisation of channel capabilities and features, ensuring investment is anchored in clear client use cases, measurable commercial value, regulatory needs and end-to-end client outcomes.
  
• Lead and develop a team of Product Owners to convert strategy into an executable global roadmap and deliver consistent, secure and reusable Cash Digital capabilities across markets, client segments and connectivity models.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy, portfolio and business partnership**  
• Own the global Cash channel strategy and roadmap across Web, H2H, SWIFT and CCS, aligning country, regional and global demand to business priorities.
  
• Act as the senior Channels counterpart to Cash Product heads and represent the portfolio in senior governance, investment and prioritisation forums.
  
• Partner with global, regional and country Cash Product heads to understand business, client and product priorities in every market.
  
• Manage senior stakeholders across global product and country management, Channels and Technology, setting expectations on scope, timing and trade-offs. Make transparent trade-offs across growth, client commitments, regulatory or scheme deadlines, resilience, simplification and platform modernisation.
  
**Product execution and prioritisation**  
• Own the global Cash backlog for Channels and rank demand using commercial value, client impact, regulatory urgency, risk, effort and delivery feasibility.
  
• Lead the working relationship between Cash, country, Channel Product and Technology teams to agree scope, dependencies, release plans and accountable outcomes.
  
• Run one intake process for all demand, sorting each request, assess client requests tied to mandates /RFPs and implementation deadlines, track regulatory requirements against deadlines.
  
• Apply a clear prioritisation framework, ringfence capacity across regulatory, client driven scope on revenue and client priority, and sequence delivery. Spot common needs across markets to deliver them as global capabilities.
  
• Maintain executive oversight of multiple initiatives running in parallel across markets, products and channels, keep a portfolio view of status, risks, milestones and cross-channel dependencies, intervening early where delivery or value is at risk.
  
**Client insight, proposition and commercialisation**  
• Build evidence-based country and client use cases covering target segments, revenue and volumes at stake, adoption barriers, competitive gaps and the cost of not acting.
  
• Define differentiated value propositions and commercialisation plans for new capabilities, partnering with Sales, Implementation, Onboarding and Client Service to drive launch readiness and adoption.
  
• Track adoption, transaction volumes, client feedback and realised benefits after launch, using insights to refine the proposition and roadmap.

**Cross-channel capability and solution leadership**  
**• Translate Cash and Payments needs into end-to-end capabilities spanning digital journeys, entitlements, approvals, connectivity, formats, payment status and reporting.**  
**• Guide solutioning across H2H connectivity (SFTP, AS2 and HTTPS), SWIFT channels (FileAct, FIN and gpi), ISO 20022 messages and legacy or local clearing formats.**  
**• Promote reusable components, standard formats and common services while safeguarding security, resilience, sanctions, fraud, accessibility and regulatory requirements.**  
**People and talent**  
**• Lead, coach and develop Product Owners, translating strategy into clear objectives and allocating capacity to the highest-value work.**  
**• Build strategic, commercial, client and channel depth across the team, strengthening prioritisation, stakeholder management, product discipline and succession capacity.**  
**• Role-model the Bank’s valued behaviours, sound risk judgement, constructive feedback, inclusion, wellbeing and accountability.**  
**Risk, controls and governance**  
**• Embed product, operational, information security, regulatory and conduct requirements throughout discovery, design, delivery, release and post-launch review.**  
**• Ensure material decisions, exceptions, residual risks and control dependencies are appropriately governed and documented.**  
**• Maintain accurate client-facing specifications, user guidance, release notes, testing support and migration plans for new or changed capabilities.**

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Must-have Skills**  
**• Cash and Payments Product Strategy**  
**• Digital Channels and Corporate Connectivity**  
**• Product Commercialisation and Value Proposition**  
**Other Skills**  
**• Portfolio Prioritisation and Investment Discipline**  
**• Client and Market Insight**  
**• Senior Stakeholder Influence**  
**• People Leadership and Product Team Development**

**Motivations**
---------------

* **Shaping client-channel strategy and turning complex Cash and Payments needs into scalable propositions with visible commercial and client value.**

**• Leading across business, product and technology boundaries to resolve competing priorities and deliver high-impact outcomes across markets.**  
**• Building empowered Product Owner teams that combine deep channel expertise with strategic thinking, disciplined execution and strong client focus.**

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Key Experiences**  
**• 15+ years of senior-level experience in Transaction Banking, Cash Management, Payments or enterprise digital channels, including product strategy, proposition development, commercialisation and execution.**  
**• Deep experience in corporate connectivity and more than one client channel, with working knowledge of H2H, SWIFT, APIs and corporate Web banking.**  
**• Strong Cash and Payments domain understanding across domestic and cross-border payments, real-time and bulk payments, payroll, receivables, liquidity, statements and reporting.**  
**• Working command of ISO 20022 payment and reporting messages, legacy MT formats, local clearing formats, and ERP or treasury management system integration.**  
**• Demonstrated experience building business cases, prioritising investments and managing multiple initiatives across countries, products and channels.**  
**• Strong experience in Portfolio management at scale, running a large backlog with many initiatives in parallel, while sharing limited delivery capacity across countries and demand types.**  
**• Proven leadership of Product Owners or Product Managers and senior-level influence across Product, Sales, Technology, Operations, Risk and Compliance.**  
**Certifications / Qualifications (only where mandatory):** **Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in business, finance, engineering, computer science or a related discipline. No role-specific certification is mandatory.**  
**Languages:** **English: professional fluency. Additional languages are advantageous where relevant to the role’s market coverage.**

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

**We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.**

**Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.**

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation** **, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.**
* **In line with our Fair Pay Charter** **, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.**
* **Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance** **, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.**
* **Time-off** **including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.**
* **Flexible working** **options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.**
* **Proactive wellbeing support** **through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.**
* **A continuous learning culture** **to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.**

**Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.**

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Leader / Product Manager -SDS2
job_description:
**Company Description**

The Nemetschek Group is a leading global vertical software and AI provider driving the digital transformation of the AEC/O and media industries. With our deep domain expertise and intelligent, connected software solutions, we enable customers to turn data into real-time insights and smarter decisions throughout the entire lifecycle of buildings and infrastructure from ideation through planning, visualization, construction, operation, and renovation.  
Our AI-powered technologies and open standards approach boost productivity, collaboration, and sustainability for architects, engineers, contractors, building operators, and creative professionals. Over 7 million users worldwide rely on our customer-centric, human-led AI solutions. Founded by Professor Georg Nemetschek in 1963, today we employ over 4,000 experts globally across 14 subsidiaries.

 **Job Description**

What we are looking for

We are hiring a **Product Manager for SDS2** who combines strong product-management fundamentals with practical understanding of **structural steel fabrication, detailing, or manufacturing**. This is not intended to be a general-purpose software PM role.

The ideal candidate understands how engineering software fits into real fabrication workflows and has an **AI-first mindset**, actively looking for ways AI can improve detailing, automation, decision-making, user productivity, and the way we build products.

Industry & Technical Background

* Strong experience with **structural steel fabrication, steel detailing, manufacturing, or closely related industrial engineering workflows**
* Ability to communicate credibly with detailers, fabricators, engineers, developers, and customers
* Bachelor's degree in **engineering, architecture, or a closely related technical field**
* Understanding of complex engineering/manufacturing workflows and the ability to translate them into software requirements

Product Management

* Ideally **5+ years of Product Management / Product Ownership experience**, preferably with AEC, engineering, manufacturing, or technical B2B software
* Demonstrated ownership of:
  + Product vision and roadmap
  + Customer discovery and requirements
  + Epics and backlog prioritization
  + Agile product development
  + Product lifecycle
  + Market and competitive analysis
  + Product launches / GTM
  + Product metrics and business outcomes
* Strong project-management capability across distributed, cross-functional teams
* Excellent written, verbal, and customer-facing communication skills
* Comfortable working directly with Engineering, UX, Sales, Support, Marketing, customers, and senior leadership.
* **Jira** for requirements, epics, backlog, and Agile development
* **Basecamp** for project/program coordination
* Customer-facing product discovery
* Structural engineering knowledge
* Fabrication shop experience
* BIM / digital fabrication workflows
* APIs, interoperability, or integrations
* Enterprise B2B software experience
* Data-driven product management

AI-First Mindset

We want someone who views **AI as a fundamental part of the future of SDS2**, not simply another feature.

Look for candidates who:

* Routinely use AI tools in their own work
* Understand practical applications of **AI/ML, copilots, agents, automation, or intelligent workflows**
* Can identify repetitive or knowledge-intensive detailing tasks that could be automated or augmented
* Can translate AI opportunities into customer problems, workflows, requirements, and measurable outcomes
* Are curious and willing to experiment rather than waiting for established industry solutions

Direct AI product experience is highly desirable but should **not outweigh steel-industry/domain knowledge**.

Strong Differentiators

Experience with one or more of the following should move a candidate **significantly higher in the recruiting funnel**:

**Steel / Detailing Software**

* SDS2
* Tekla Structures
* Advance Steel
* Bocad
* ProSteel
* Other structural steel detailing / fabrication systems

**Engineering / Manufacturing Software**

* SolidWorks
* Autodesk Inventor
* Creo
* CATIA
* Bentley engineering products
* Other CAD/CAM/CAE, BIM, PLM, or fabrication software

  
**Additional Information**

#NemetschekIndia #LI-Hybrid #LI-NB1

title: Senior Lead Product Owner
job_description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

**Overview**

Boeing is the world's largest aerospace company and leading manufacturer of commercial airplanes and defense, space and security systems. We are engineers and technicians. Skilled scientists and thinkers. Bold innovators and dreamers. Join us, and you can build something better for yourself, for our customers and for the world.

As a leading global aerospace company, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. As a top U.S. exporter, the company leverages the talents of a global supplier base to advance economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. Boeing’s team is committed to innovating for the future, leading with sustainability, and cultivating a culture based on the company’s core values of safety, quality and integrity.

**Technology for today and tomorrow**

The Boeing India Engineering & Technology Center (BIETC) is a 5500+ engineering workforce that contributes to global aerospace growth. Our engineers deliver cutting-edge R&D, innovation, and high-quality engineering work in global markets, and leverage new-age technologies such as AI/ML, IIoT, Cloud, Model-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, shaping the future of aerospace.

**People-driven culture**

At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts – enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected. No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping people’s careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing.

With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace.

**Position Overview:**

**Boeing Digital Services org** is currently looking for a **Senior Lead Product Owner** to join the team in **Bangalore, IN.** In this role you will drive product ownership excellence across a portfolio of maintenance and flight product suits. You will establish and scale product management practices, processes, standards, and governance across the organization while providing strategic direction and coaching to Product Owners and Development teams. You will serve as a trusted advisor to product, engineering, business, technology, and executive stakeholders. You will influence outcomes across multiple teams and products without direct authority and ensure that product decisions are driven by customer value, business impact, data, risk, and delivery feasibility.

The role combines enterprise-level Product Owner responsibilities with selected Product Manager responsibilities, including portfolio strategy, market analysis, product positioning, investment planning, customer discovery, business case development, and product lifecycle management. You will work closely with Developers, Product Owners, Greenfield Leadership, Data Scientists, and Architects to deliver product features and capabilities that keep AI and ML at the center of our solutions. You will be helping create new product offerings as well as modernizing systems that have been running the business for years, while building new ones designed to run it for years to come.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Define and communicate portfolio-level product vision, strategy, objectives, outcomes, and roadmaps for aviation / MRO products, platforms, and capabilities.

* Evaluate customer needs, market trends, competitive offerings, emerging technologies, and internal capabilities to identify opportunities for new products, enhancements, modernization, consolidation, or retirement.

* Establish and maintain consistent product management and product ownership practices, processes, standards, governance, templates, and decision-making frameworks across the organization.

* Provide strategic direction, mentoring, and coaching to Product Owners, Product Managers, and Business Analysts in product discovery, prioritization, backlog management, stakeholder engagement, and value delivery.

* Guide teams in translating customer and business needs into well-defined epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements, and measurable outcomes.

* Lead portfolio-level prioritization and resolve cross-product dependencies, competing demands, sequencing decisions, resource constraints, and delivery trade-offs.

* Partner with customers and stakeholders to validate product concepts, business problems, solution alternatives, priorities, prototypes, and early product definitions.

* Define and monitor product and portfolio success measures, including customer satisfaction, adoption, operational performance, financial value, quality, delivery, and business outcomes.

* Represent the customer and business perspective throughout product development, Agile delivery, Program Increment planning, release planning, system demonstrations, and operational readiness activities.

* Partner with engineering, architecture, security, quality, operations, and support teams to evaluate technical options, integrations, scalability, technical debt, maintainability, resilience, and non-functional requirements.

* Communicate portfolio priorities, roadmap changes, investment recommendations, delivery progress, performance results, risks, and decisions to customers, stakeholders, and senior leadership while driving continuous improvement in product management maturity and value delivery.

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* Bachelor’s degree is required as basic qualification.
* 15+ years relevant experience in software development including full-stack web development, experience with modern software product development, integration, and delivery

* Experience integrating AI, ML, or LLM capabilities into software applications.

job_description:
**WHO WE ARE:**

Zinnia is the leading technology platform for accelerating life and annuities growth. With innovative enterprise solutions and data insights, Zinnia simplifies the experience of buying, selling, and administering insurance products. All of which enables more people to protect their financial futures. Our success is driven by a commitment to three core values: be bold, team up, deliver value – and that we do. Zinnia has over $180 billion in assets under administration, serves 100+ carrier clients, 2500 distributors and partners, and over 2 million policyholders.

**WHO YOU ARE:**

The Senior Product Manager leads the Product Life Cycle and strongly contributes to the research & development activities related to the design and development of our products and qualification or re-qualification of new and existing products. The individual will work with Zinnia's Product Organization to ensure alignment with organization's strategy and vision.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* Lead & contribute into the execution of product lifecycle processes for our Insurtech products/platforms, work with cross-functional teams to ensure fulfilment of product requirements, evaluates product performance and transition products from development to commercialization.
* Lead technical discussions with Engineering teams & thoroughly manage technical/business requirements.
* Assists in determining product delivery and deployment dates for new product releases, feature and maintenance releases and regular corrective service or service pack releases.
* Mentor a lean team of Product Managers while acting as a technical consultant to the product organization and leads research and prototyping of innovative technologies and products.
* Ensures the technology and architectural roadmap of engineering is properly aligned with and supports the product/business road map
* Acts as a customer liaison on technical issues related to product integration, custom development and requirements.
* May lead major releases and ensure feature enhancements respond to customer requests.
* Responsible for product delivery managing schedules and tasks related to all aspects of product development.

**WHAT YOU'LL NEED:**

* **9+ years of experience into Product Management, including analyzing software/product design, development, and deployment.**
* **Domain expertise in US Life Insurance & Annuity.**
* Bachelor's/Master's or equivalent Degree in technology or related field
* **Strong Background of working as a Technical & Functional Product Manager or Business Analyst/Product Analyst in an enterprise environment.**
* **Hands-on understanding of API Integration, SQL, Data Analysis etc.**
* **Strong understanding of SDLC & technology system interfaces, data integration.**
* An SME who performs work with a high degree of latitude; handles the most complex issues.
* Possess strong Communication skills, Problem-solving & Analytical thinking skills.
* Can lead individual assignments & deliver with strong expertise
* Expert level experience in delivery methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and the use of relevant tools
* Ability to influence, lead, and work as part of a cross-functional in a global team setup

**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?**

Zinnia offers excellent career progression and competitive compensation. We offer great benefits, including health/dental insurance, parental leave, profit sharing, PF, incentive/bonus opportunity, tuition reimbursement, and so much more. We're looking for the best and brightest innovators in the industry to join our team. At Zinnia, you collaborate with smart, creative professionals who are dedicated to delivering cutting-edge technologies, deeper data insights, and enhanced services to transform how insurance is done. Visit our website at www.zinnia.com for more information. Apply by completing the online application on the careers section of our website. We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Sr Product Manager, Marketing Technology
job_description:
**It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!**

Job Description:

As a Sr. Product Manager for Marketing Technology, you are responsible for the ideation, development, launch, and optimization of the internal platforms that power how Ingram Micro plans, sells, executes, and bills for marketing programs with our vendor and channel partners. You have a deep understanding of marketing operations and marketing-centric order-to-cash processes, from program planning, scoping, and approvals through contracting, execution, proof of performance, claiming, invoicing, and revenue recognition. You bring a “build to replace what we buy” mindset: studying how work gets done today across people, processes, and purchased tools, identifying where fragmented or costly systems slow us down, and building more efficient, integrated solutions that shorten time to value and reduce total cost of ownership. You will partner closely with engineering, architecture, finance, and marketing operations teams to retire legacy tools, consolidate workflows, and lay the data and integration foundations for automation and AI-driven orchestration. A successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to clearly define a problem statement, build a fact-based business case, deliver a product vision, prioritize initiatives informed by data, drive execution, and champion the change management adoption plans with our partners.

The Sr. Product Manager, Marketing Technology for Ingram Micro’s Global Platform Team will be a key leader on the Marketing Engine Team. They will be responsible for:

* Setting a product vision and strategy that aligns with company, organization, and team level objectives.
* Developing and executing the product roadmap for marketing technology. This includes replacing legacy and third-party tools with internally built capabilities, and integrating with enterprise ERP, finance, work management, and content systems.
* Studying current operational and technological ways of working – mapping processes, hand-offs, systems, and costs – to identify where consolidation, automation, or a build-versus-buy decision will save time and money.
* Building the business case for build-versus-buy decisions, weighing license and contract costs, operational effort, security and compliance risk, and time to value.
* Owning end-to-end marketing order-to-cash workflows and partnering with finance and accounting to ensure marketing requirements for billing, invoicing, claims, and revenue recognition are represented in enterprise programs.
* Leading collaboration across UX, Engineering, Data, and Business teams, and serving as SME to the global marketing and finance community to validate that features solve their business and partner needs and are easy to understand.
* Leading migration and decommissioning plans for replaced systems, including data migration, UAT, pilot rollouts, and country-by-country change management.
* Owning the excellence of your product(s) - be scrappy, solve problems, and take an entrepreneurial approach to deliver against business outcomes.
Defining, monitoring, and analyzing product and business metrics such as cycle time, manual effort removed, cost avoided, and adoption, and feeding learnings back into the product development process.  

What you bring to the role:

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, engineering, science, and a related technical emphasis is required. Preferred: an MBA (or equivalent) from a top-tier institution, or equivalent business experience.
* 5-8 years of product management experience, ideally leading internal platform, business systems, or marketing technology products.
* Familiarity with marketing-centric order-to-cash processes, systems, use cases, and complexities, such as partner marketing funds, program scoping and approvals, contracts, proof of performance, claims, and invoicing.
* Demonstrated experience assessing current-state operations and technology, and delivering systems that replaced purchased or legacy tools while reducing cost and time to value.
* Working knowledge of enterprise integration patterns (APIs, ERP, workflow and rules engines) and the ability to discuss architecture tradeoffs with engineering.
* Experience working with go-to-market, marketing operations, and finance teams to drive adoption of products across partners & internal associates.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to derive meaningful insights from complex data sets.
* Exceptional cross-functional collaboration skills and ability to influence without authority.
* Understanding and experience in compliance with data privacy, security, and financial controls requirements.
* Direct hands-on experience working with Engineering teams to clearly scope, define, detail, and prioritize product requirements and maintain a well-groomed backlog.
* Experience developing and launching successful software products.
* Outstanding communication and presentation skills (verbal and written). Should be comfortable presenting to executive staff, key stakeholders, and large teams.
* Passion for quality and commitment to creating efficient, intuitive experiences that remove manual work.
* Ability to work with remote partners and team members via online tools across different time zones.
* Position may require occasional travel, including international travel.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
**Why Work Here**

* Headquarters is in Charlotte, NC
* Recently expanded to nearshore,Hyderabad
* isolved ranked for SMB Payroll in 2023 Sapient Report
* Voted top places to work in USA 2023

**Job Description**

Associate Product Manager, Suite Experience

**Summary/objective**

isolved is modernizing the user experience across its HCM platform, built on a shared design system. In this role you will work from our Hyderabad office as the day-to-day product owner for three development teams, each building new pages and experiences for a different product area at the same time.

The design system is already in place, so the job is less about designing from scratch and more about building the right thing correctly. You will make sure each new page does everything the current one does, works for every user role, and handles real-world edge cases. You will also answer the many small product and UX questions that come up during development. You will work closely with US-based product leadership, and the role requires regular overlap with US business hours for handoffs, planning, and decisions.

**Core Job Duties**

* Document how current pages work, including fields, actions, user permissions, and edge cases, so nothing is lost when they are rebuilt
* Own backlog refinement and sprint readiness for three development teams working in parallel
* Write user stories and acceptance criteria that cover page behavior, validation, error and empty states, role-based access, and accessibility
* Answer day-to-day product and UX questions from developers, using the existing design system and escalating only where a new pattern is needed
